        rev_features = rev_agg.reindex(features.index).fillna(0.0)

    # --- Платежи ---
    pay = payments[(payments['order_id'].isin(order_ids))].copy()
    if pay.empty:
        pay_features = pd.DataFrame({'payment_count': 0.0, 'payment_sum': 0.0,
                                     'payment_mean': 0.0, 'payment_std': 0.0,
                                     'payment_installments_mean': 0.0,
                                     'payment_installments_max': 0.0,
                                     'payment_types_unique': 0.0}, index=features.index)
    else:
        pay_merged = pay.merge(items_sel[['order_id', 'product_id']].drop_duplicates(), on='order_id')
        pay_agg = pay_merged.groupby('product_id').agg(
            payment_count=('payment_value', 'size'),
            payment_sum=('payment_value', 'sum'),
            payment_mean=('payment_value', 'mean'),
            payment_std=('payment_value', 'std'),
            payment_installments_mean=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
            payment_installments_max=('payment_installments', 'max'),
            payment_types_unique=('payment_type', 'nunique')
        )
        pay_features = pay_agg.reindex(features.index).fillna(0.0)

    # --- Объединяем всё в единый DataFrame ---
    final_features = features.join(rev_features).join(pay_features)

    # Дропаем вспомогательные временные колонки (first_ts, last_ts)
    final_features.drop(columns=['first_ts', 'last_ts'], inplace=True)

    # Приводим к числовому типу и заполняем пропуски (например, у новых продуктов)
    final_features = final_features.astype(float)

    # Если какие-то товары из entity_ids отсутствуют в истории – заполните нулями
    final_features = final_features.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0.0)

    return final_features

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Преобразуем seed_time в Timestamp на всякий случай
    seed = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)
    
    orders = db['orders']
    order_items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']
    
    # ---------- 1. Базовые данные: заказы (до seed_time) + их позиции ----------
    # Фильтруем заказы, созданные до seed
    orders_before = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] <= seed]
    orders_before = orders_before[['order_id', 'customer_id', 'order_status',
                                   'order_purchase_timestamp',
                                   'order_delivered_customer_date',
                                   'order_estimated_delivery_date']]
    
    # Присоединяем позиции (все, они принадлежат выбранному кругу заказов)
    items = order_items[['order_id', 'product_id', 'seller_id', 'price', 'freight_value']]
    data = items.merge(orders_before, on='order_id', how='inner')
    
    # Сразу создаём признак «кол-во дней до seed»
    data['days_before'] = (seed - data['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.days
    
    # ---------- 2. Базовые агрегаты (по всем данным до seed) ----------
    base = data.groupby('product_id').agg(
        total_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
        total_units=('order_id', 'count'),
        total_sales=('price', 'sum'),
        avg_sale_price=('price', 'mean'),
        std_sale_price=('price', 'std'),
        total_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
        avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
        total_customers=('customer_id', 'nunique'),
        total_sellers=('seller_id', 'nunique'),
        last_order_ts=('order_purchase_timestamp', 'max'),
        first_order_ts=('order_purchase_timestamp', 'min')
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Признаки, связанные с временем и частотой
    base['days_since_last'] = (seed - base['last_order_ts']).dt.days
    base['history_days'] = (base['last_order_ts'] - base['first_order_ts']).dt.days
    base['orders_per_day'] = base['total_orders'] / (base['history_days'].clip(lower=1))
    # средний интервал между заказами (если заказов > 1)
    base['avg_days_between'] = np.where(
        base['total_orders'] > 1,
        (base['history_days'] / (base['total_orders'] - 1)).clip(lower=0),
        0
    )
    # частота заказов в месяц (для справки)
    base['orders_per_month'] = base['total_orders'] / ((base['history_days'] / 30).clip(lower=0.1))
    
    # ---------- 3. Окна продаж за последние N дней ----------
    for w in [7, 30, 60, 90]:
        # Окна: все покупки, где days_before <= w (т.е. не старше w дней)
        window_data = data[data['days_before'] <= w]
        group_win = window_data.groupby('product_id').agg(
            orders_last=('order_id', 'nunique'),
            units_last=('order_id', 'count'),
            sales_last=('price', 'sum'),
            freight_last=('freight_value', 'sum')
        ).reset_index()
        group_win.columns = ['product_id',
                             f'orders_last_{w}',
                             f'units_last_{w}',
                             f'sales_last_{w}',
                             f'freight_last_{w}']
        base = base.merge(group_win, on='product_id', how='left')
    
    # ---------- 4. Отзывы (только созданные до seed) ----------
    rev = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] <= seed][['order_id', 'review_score']]
    # Связываем отзывы с товарами из data (через order_id)
    # Используем уникальные пары (order_id, product_id)
    order_product = data[['order_id', 'product_id']].drop_duplicates()
    rev_with_product = rev.merge(order_product, on='order_id', how='left')
    
    rev_agg = rev_with_product.groupby('product_id').agg(
        n_reviews=('review_score', 'count'),
        avg_review=('review_score', 'mean'),
        std_review=('review_score', 'std'),
        share_high_review=('review_score', lambda x: np.mean(x >= 4))
    ).reset_index()
    base = base.merge(rev_agg, on='product_id', how='left')
    
    # ---------- 5. Платёжные данные (до seed) ----------
    pay = payments[payments['ts'] <= seed][['order_id', 'payment_type',
                                            'payment_installments', 'payment_value']]
    pay_with_product = pay.merge(order_product, on='order_id', how='left')
    
    pay_agg = pay_with_product.groupby('product_id').agg(
        n_payments=('payment_value', 'count'),
        total_payment_value=('payment_value', 'sum'),
        avg_payment_value=('payment_value', 'mean'),
        avg_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
        n_payment_types=('payment_type', 'nunique')
    ).reset_index()
    base = base.merge(pay_agg, on='product_id', how='left')
    
    # ---------- 6. Реиндексация и заполнение пропусков ----------
    base.set_index('product_id', inplace=True)
    
    # Индексируем по entity_ids, недостающие продукты станут NaN
    feature_df = base.reindex(entity_ids)
    
    # Заменяем NaN числовыми значениями (0 — для количества и сумм)
    # Дни с момента последней покупки/первая покупка: если нет данных, ставим большое число
    if 'days_since_last' in feature_df.columns:
        feature_df['days_since_last'] = feature_df['days_since_last'].fillna(365 * 10)
    if 'history_days' in feature_df.columns:
        feature_df['history_days'] = feature_df['history_days'].fillna(365 * 10)
    if 'orders_per_day' in feature_df.columns:
        feature_df['orders_per_day'] = feature_df['orders_per_day'].fillna(0)
    if 'avg_days_between' in feature_df.columns:
        feature_df['avg_days_between'] = feature_df['avg_days_between'].fillna(365 * 10)
    if 'orders_per_month' in feature_df.columns:
        feature_df['orders_per_month'] = feature_df['orders_per_month'].fillna(0)
    
    # Заполняем остальные пропуски нулями (например, суммы, агрегаты без данных)
    feature_df = feature_df.fillna(0)
    
    # Убираем временные метки, если они остались (last_order_ts и first_order_ts)
    for col in ['last_order_ts', 'first_order_ts']:
        if col in feature_df.columns:
            feature_df.drop(col, axis=1, inplace=True)
    
    # Приводим к числовому типу, чтобы избежать возможных проблем
    for col in feature_df.columns:
        if not pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(feature_df[col]):
            feature_df[col] = feature_df[col].astype(float)
    
    return feature_df

def get_features(db, entity_ids, seed_time):
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    # payments – не используем в этой версии

    # фильтруем заказы только до seed_time
    orders_past = orders[orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] <= seed_time]
    orders_past = orders_past[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp"]]

    # присоединяем order_items (позиции заказов) и фильтруем по нужным товарам
    items = order_items.merge(orders_past, on="order_id", how="inner")
    items = items[items["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)]

    # базовые колонки результата (если нет исторических данных – всё нулю/NaN)
    result = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)
    result["total_orders"] = 0          # уникальных заказов
    result["total_qty"] = 0             # количество позиций в заказах
    result["total_sales"] = 0           # сумма цен
    result["total_freight"] = 0         # сумма доставки
    result["avg_price"] = np.nan
    result["avg_freight"] = np.nan
    result["avg_review_score"] = np.nan
    result["review_count"] = 0
    result["n_sellers"] = 0
    result["recency_days"] = 9999       # дней с последней покупки
    result["age_days"] = 9999           # дней с первой покупки
    for window in (30, 90, 180, 365):
        result[f"orders_{window}"] = 0

    if items.empty:
        return result

    # агрегирование по товарам
    grp = items.groupby("product_id")
    base = grp.agg(
        total_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_qty=("order_id", "size"),                 # число строк = кол-во позиций
        sum_price=("price", "sum"),
        sum_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        n_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
        last_purchase=("order_purchase_timestamp", "max"),
        first_purchase=("order_purchase_timestamp", "min")
    )

    # отзывы – считаем на уникальных парах (product_id, order_id)
    unique_pairs = items[["product_id", "order_id"]].drop_duplicates()
    unique_pairs = unique_pairs.merge(
        reviews[(reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time)][["order_id", "review_score"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    review_stats = unique_pairs.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        review_count=("review_score", "count")   # count игнорирует NaN
    )

    # окна – уникальные заказы за период
    unique_orders = items[["product_id", "order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp"]].drop_duplicates(
        subset=["product_id", "order_id"]
    )
    for window in (30, 90, 180, 365):
        cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=window)
        counts = unique_orders.groupby("product_id").apply(
            lambda df: (df["order_purchase_timestamp"] >= cutoff).sum()
        )
        base[f"orders_{window}"] = counts

    # рецензины и окнальные присоединяем
    base = base.join(review_stats, how="left")

    # recency и age
    recency = (seed_time - base["last_purchase"]).dt.days.fillna(9999)
    age = (seed_time - base["first_purchase"]).dt.days.fillna(9999)
    base["recency_days"] = recency
    base["age_days"] = age

    # убираем временные метки
    base = base.drop(columns=["last_purchase", "first_purchase"])
    base.index.name = None

    # обновляем результаты: заполняем существующие, для отсутствующих оставляем 0/NaN
    result = result.combine_first(base)

    return result

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import numpy as np
    
    orders = db['orders']
    order_items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']
    
    product_ids = list(entity_ids)
    
    # filter order_items to those that occurred at or before seed_time
    items = order_items[order_items['ts'] <= seed_time].copy()
    
    features = []
    
    # ---- Base product statistics (all time up to seed_time) ----
    if not items.empty:
        # attach customer_id
        m = items.merge(orders[['order_id', 'customer_id']], on='order_id', how='left')
        base = m.groupby('product_id').agg(
            total_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
            total_units=('order_item_id', 'count'),
            total_price=('price', 'sum'),
            total_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
            avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
            avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
            min_price=('price', 'min'),
            max_price=('price', 'max'),
            n_customers=('customer_id', 'nunique'),
            n_sellers=('seller_id', 'nunique'),
            first_ts=('ts', 'min'),
            last_ts=('ts', 'max')
        ).reset_index()
        base['avg_units_per_order'] = base['total_units'] / base['total_orders']
    else:
        base = pd.DataFrame(columns=[
            'product_id', 'total_orders', 'total_units', 'total_price', 'total_freight',
            'avg_price', 'avg_freight', 'min_price', 'max_price',
            'n_customers', 'n_sellers', 'first_ts', 'last_ts', 'avg_units_per_order'
        ])
    features.append(base)
    
    # ---- Rolling windows (30 / 60 / 90 days) ----
    for win in [30, 60, 90]:
        col_count = f'count_orders_{win}d'
        col_units = f'count_units_{win}d'
        col_price = f'sum_price_{win}d'
        win_mask = (seed_time - items['ts']).dt.days <= win
        if win_mask.any():
            tmp = items[win_mask].groupby('product_id').agg(
                **{col_count: ('order_id', 'nunique'),
                   col_units: ('order_item_id', 'count'),
                   col_price: ('price', 'sum')}
            ).reset_index()
        else:
            tmp = pd.DataFrame(columns=['product_id', col_count, col_units, col_price])
        features.append(tmp)
    
    # ---- Review based features ----
    if not items.empty:
        # only reviews available up to seed_time
        rev_sliced = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] <= seed_time]
        # join on order_id, then each product receives the review score of its order
        joined = items[['order_id', 'product_id']].merge(
            rev_sliced[['order_id', 'review_score']], on='order_id', how='left'
        )
        joined = joined[joined['review_score'].notna()]
        if not joined.empty:
            rev_agg = joined.groupby('product_id').agg(
                review_count=('review_score', 'count'),
                review_mean=('review_score', 'mean'),
                review_std=('review_score', 'std')
            ).reset_index()
        else:
            rev_agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=['product_id', 'review_count', 'review_mean', 'review_std'])
    else:
        rev_agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=['product_id', 'review_count', 'review_mean', 'review_std'])
    features.append(rev_agg)
    
    # ---- payment related features ----
    if not items.empty:
        # unique product-order pairs
        unique_orders = items[['order_id', 'product_id']].drop_duplicates()
        # aggregate payments to order level
        pay_order = payments.groupby('order_id').agg(
            total_payment=('payment_value', 'sum'),
            avg_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
            num_payments=('payment_sequential', 'count')
        ).reset_index()
        merged_pay = unique_orders.merge(pay_order, on='order_id', how='left')
        if not merged_pay.empty:
            pay_agg = merged_pay.groupby('product_id').agg(
                mean_order_payment=('total_payment', 'mean'),
                std_order_payment=('total_payment', 'std'),
                mean_installments=('avg_installments', 'mean'),
                mean_payments_per_order=('num_payments', 'mean')
            ).reset_index()
        else:
            pay_agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=['product_id', 'mean_order_payment', 'std_order_payment',
                                           'mean_installments', 'mean_payments_per_order'])
    else:
        pay_agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=['product_id', 'mean_order_payment', 'std_order_payment',
                                       'mean_installments', 'mean_payments_per_order'])
    features.append(pay_agg)
    
    # ---- combine all features ----
    # merge outside, starting from the first frame
    result = features[0]
    for df in features[1:]:
        result = result.merge(df, on='product_id', how='outer')
    
    # If everything is empty, we still need a DataFrame with product_id column
    if result.empty:
        result = pd.DataFrame({'product_id': product_ids})
    elif 'product_id' not in result.columns:
        result['product_id'] = product_ids
    
    # Time-based features
    if 'first_ts' in result.columns:
        result['days_since_first'] = (seed_time - result['first_ts']).dt.days
        result.drop(columns='first_ts', inplace=True)
    else:
        result['days_since_first'] = np.nan
    
    if 'last_ts' in result.columns:
        result['days_since_last'] = (seed_time - result['last_ts']).dt.days
        result.drop(columns='last_ts', inplace=True)
    else:
        result['days_since_last'] = np.nan
    
    # overall frequency per day
    freq_denom = result['days_since_first'].clip(lower=1)
    result['order_frequency_per_day'] = result['total_orders'] / freq_denom
    
    # reindex to the requested product_ids
    result = result.set_index('product_id').reindex(product_ids)
    result = result.fillna(0)
    
    return result

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    entities = list(entity_ids)
    product_set = set(entities)

    orders = db["orders"]
    items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # Base DataFrame indexed by all requested product_ids
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=entities)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Sales and order items features (using order_items.ts as purchase time)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    mask = (items["product_id"].isin(product_set)) & (items["ts"] <= seed_time)
    hist = items[mask].copy()

    if not hist.empty:
        grp = hist.groupby("product_id")
        agg = grp.agg(
            n_items=("order_item_id", "count"),
            n_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
            n_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
            total_price=("price", "sum"),
            total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
            avg_price=("price", "mean"),
            min_price=("price", "min"),
            max_price=("price", "max"),
            std_price=("price", "std"),
            avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
            max_ts=("ts", "max"),
            min_ts=("ts", "min"),
        )
        # Recency and span
        agg["recency_days"] = (seed_time - agg["max_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
        agg["age_days"] = (agg["max_ts"] - agg["min_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
        agg["span_days"] = (seed_time - agg["min_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
        agg.drop(columns=["max_ts", "min_ts"], inplace=True)

        # Merge basic aggregation into features
        features = features.join(agg, how="left")

        # 7/30/90-day windows
        for win in (7, 30, 90):
            start = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=win)
            wmask = hist["ts"] >= start
            wdf = hist[wmask]
            if not wdf.empty:
                wgrp = wdf.groupby("product_id").agg(
                    **{
                        f"n_items_{win}d": ("order_item_id", "count"),
                        f"n_orders_{win}d": ("order_id", "nunique"),
                        f"revenue_{win}d": ("price", "sum"),
                    }
                )
                features = features.join(wgrp, how="left")
    else:
        # No historical item rows → all aggregate features will be zero
        # (we will fill missing columns later)
        pass

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Customer features
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    if not hist.empty:
        # Unique order-product pairs
        op = hist[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates()
        cust = op.merge(
            orders[["order_id", "customer_id"]].drop_duplicates(),
            on="order_id",
            how="left",
        )
        if not cust.empty:
            n_cust = cust.groupby("product_id")["customer_id"].nunique().rename("n_customers")
            features = features.join(n_cust, how="left")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Review features (reviews are associated with orders)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    if not hist.empty:
        op = hist[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates()
        rev = op.merge(reviews, on="order_id", how="left")
        # Only reviews created before / at seed_time
        rev = rev[rev["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time] if not rev.empty else rev

        if not rev.empty:
            rev_agg = rev.groupby("product_id").agg(
                n_reviews=("review_score", "size"),
                avg_review=("review_score", "mean"),
                min_review=("review_score", "min"),
                max_review=("review_score", "max"),
                std_review=("review_score", "std"),
                n_positive=("review_score", lambda x: (x >= 4).sum()),
            )
            features = features.join(rev_agg, how="left")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Payment features
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    if not hist.empty:
        op = hist[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates()
        pay = payments[payments["ts"] <= seed_time]
        pay = op.merge(pay, on="order_id", how="left")
        if not pay.empty:
            pay_agg = pay.groupby("product_id").agg(
                total_payment=("payment_value", "sum"),
                avg_payment=("payment_value", "mean"),
                max_payment=("payment_value", "max"),
                n_payments=("payment_sequential", "size"),
            )
            features = features.join(pay_agg, how="left")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. Clean up columns: convert to numeric, fill NaN, set recency
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # recency_days: if no previous sales use a large numeric value
    if "recency_days" in features.columns:
        features["recency_days"] = features["recency_days"].fillna(9999.0)
        features = features.astype({f: "float64" for f in features.columns if f != "recency_days"})
    # fill all other columns with 0
    features = features.fillna(0.0)

    # Ensure index exactly matches given entity_ids
    features = features.reindex(entities)

    # If no columns were generated (e.g., all products had no history),
    # add a constant dummy column to avoid empty DataFrame
    if features.shape[1] == 0:
        features["constant"] = 0.0

    return features

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    window_30d = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    window_90d = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    window_180d = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)

    features = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)
    features.index.name = "product_id"

    oi = order_items[order_items["ts"] < seed_time].copy()
    oi = oi[oi["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)]

    def _agg_oi_items(x):
        total_units = x["order_item_id"].count()
        total_revenue = (x["price"] + x["freight_value"]).sum()
        avg_price = x["price"].mean() if total_units > 0 else 0.0
        avg_freight = x["freight_value"].mean() if total_units > 0 else 0.0
        last_sale_ts = x["ts"].max()
        last_sale_age = (seed_time - last_sale_ts).total_seconds() / (24 * 3600) if total_units > 0 else 180.0

        units_30d = x[x["ts"] >= window_30d]["order_item_id"].count()
        units_90d = x[x["ts"] >= window_90d]["order_item_id"].count()
        units_180d = x[x["ts"] >= window_180d]["order_item_id"].count()
        revenue_90d = x[x["ts"] >= window_90d][["price", "freight_value"]].sum().sum()
        demand_ratio = units_30d / (units_90d + 1)

        return pd.Series({
            "total_units": total_units,
            "total_revenue": total_revenue,
            "avg_price": avg_price,
            "avg_freight": avg_freight,
            "last_sale_age": last_sale_age,
            "units_30d": units_30d,
            "units_90d": units_90d,
            "units_180d": units_180d,
            "revenue_90d": revenue_90d,
            "demand_ratio_30_90": demand_ratio
        })

    oi_agg = oi.groupby("product_id").apply(_agg_oi_items)
    features = features.join(oi_agg, how="left")
    for col in ["total_units", "total_revenue", "avg_price", "avg_freight",
                "units_30d", "units_90d", "units_180d", "revenue_90d", "demand_ratio_30_90"]:
        features[col] = features[col].fillna(0)
    features["last_sale_age"] = features["last_sale_age"].fillna(180)

    reviews_with_products = reviews.merge(
        order_items[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates(),
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    rwp = reviews_with_products[
        (reviews_with_products["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)) &
        (reviews_with_products["review_creation_date"] < seed_time)
    ].copy()

    def _agg_reviews(x):
        total_reviews = x["review_score"].count()
        avg_score = x["review_score"].mean() if total_reviews > 0 else 3.0
        count_90d = x[x["review_creation_date"] >= window_90d]["review_score"].count()
        has_comment = x["review_comment_message"].notna().sum()
        return pd.Series({
            "total_reviews": total_reviews,
            "avg_review_score": avg_score,
            "reviews_90d": count_90d,
            "comment_count": has_comment
        })

    review_agg = rwp.groupby("product_id").apply(_agg_reviews)
    features = features.join(review_agg, how="left")
    features["total_reviews"] = features["total_reviews"].fillna(0)
    features["avg_review_score"] = features["avg_review_score"].fillna(3.0)
    features["reviews_90d"] = features["reviews_90d"].fillna(0)
    features["comment_count"] = features["comment_count"].fillna(0)

    payments_with_products = payments.merge(
        order_items[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates(),
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    pwp = payments_with_products[
        (payments_with_products["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)) &
        (payments_with_products["ts"] < seed_time)
    ].copy()

    def _agg_payments(x):
        total_orders = x["order_id"].nunique()
        if total_orders == 0:
            return pd.Series({
                "total_payment_orders": 0,
                "installment_ratio": 0.5,
                "avg_installments": 1.0,
                "avg_payment_value": 0.0
            })
        orders_with_installments = x[x["payment_installments"] > 1]["order_id"].nunique()
        ratio_install = orders_with_installments / total_orders
        avg_install = x["payment_installments"].mean()
        avg_payment = x["payment_value"].mean()
        return pd.Series({
            "total_payment_orders": total_orders,
            "installment_ratio": ratio_install,
            "avg_installments": avg_install,
            "avg_payment_value": avg_payment
        })

    payment_agg = pwp.groupby("product_id").apply(_agg_payments)
    features = features.join(payment_agg, how="left")
    features["total_payment_orders"] = features["total_payment_orders"].fillna(0)
    features["installment_ratio"] = features["installment_ratio"].fillna(0.5)
    features["avg_installments"] = features["avg_installments"].fillna(1.0)
    features["avg_payment_value"] = features["avg_payment_value"].fillna(0.0)

    return features.reindex(entity_ids)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Extract tables from database
    orders_df = db["orders"]
    items_df = db["order_items"]
    reviews_df = db["reviews"]
    payments_df = db["payments"]
    # Ensure seed_time is datetime
    seed_ts = pd.to_datetime(seed_time)
    # Define temporal windows
    window_30 = seed_ts - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    window_90 = seed_ts - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    window_180 = seed_ts - pd.Timedelta(days=180)
    # Create base entity DataFrame indexed by input product IDs
    base = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)
    # 1. Merge order items with orders to filter valid (delivered) historical sales
    # Include only orders that were delivered and purchased before seed time
    item_order = pd.merge(
        items_df,
        orders_df[["order_id", "order_status"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    valid_sales = item_order[
        (item_order["order_status"] == "delivered") &
        (item_order["ts"] < seed_ts)
    ].copy()
    # Add window flags to valid sales
    valid_sales["w30"] = (valid_sales["ts"] >= window_30) & (valid_sales["ts"] < seed_ts)
    valid_sales["w90"] = (valid_sales["ts"] >= window_90) & (valid_sales["ts"] < seed_ts)
    valid_sales["w180"] = (valid_sales["ts"] >= window_180) & (valid_sales["ts"] < seed_ts)
    valid_sales["all_hist"] = valid_sales["ts"] < seed_ts
    # 2. Compute sales volume and monetary value features
    valid_sales["total_rev"] = valid_sales["price"] + valid_sales["freight_value"]
    # Masked values for windowed sums
    valid_sales["rev_w30"] = valid_sales["total_rev"] * valid_sales["w30"].astype(float)
    valid_sales["rev_w90"] = valid_sales["total_rev"] * valid_sales["w90"].astype(float)
    valid_sales["rev_w180"] = valid_sales["total_rev"] * valid_sales["w180"].astype(float)
    valid_sales["price_w30"] = valid_sales["price"] * valid_sales["w30"].astype(float)
    valid_sales["price_w90"] = valid_sales["price"] * valid_sales["w90"].astype(float)
    valid_sales["price_w180"] = valid_sales["price"] * valid_sales["w180"].astype(float)
    # Aggregate sales features per product
    sales_agg = valid_sales.groupby("product_id").agg(
        cnt_w30=("w30", "sum"),
        cnt_w90=("w90", "sum"),
        cnt_w180=("w180", "sum"),
        cnt_total=("all_hist", "sum"),
        rev_w30=("rev_w30", "sum"),
        rev_w90=("rev_w90", "sum"),
        rev_w180=("rev_w180", "sum"),
        rev_total=("total_rev", "sum"),
        sum_price_w30=("price_w30", "sum"),
        sum_price_w90=("price_w90", "sum"),
        sum_price_w180=("price_w180", "sum"),
        sum_price_total=("price", "sum")
    ).reset_index()
    sales_agg = sales_agg.set_index("product_id")
    # Merge to base DataFrame
    base = base.join(sales_agg, how="left")
    # Fill missing values (no sales) with 0
    sales_cols = ["cnt_w30", "cnt_w90", "cnt_w180", "cnt_total",
                  "rev_w30", "rev_w90", "rev_w180", "rev_total",
                  "sum_price_w30", "sum_price_w90", "sum_price_w180", "sum_price_total"]
    base[sales_cols] = base[sales_cols].fillna(0)
    # Compute average price features (handle division by 0)
    base["avg_price_w30"] = np.where(
        base["cnt_w30"] > 0,
        base["sum_price_w30"] / base["cnt_w30"],
        0.0
    )
    base["avg_price_w90"] = np.where(
        base["cnt_w90"] > 0,
        base["sum_price_w90"] / base["cnt_w90"],
        0.0
    )
    base["avg_price_w180"] = np.where(
        base["cnt_w180"] > 0,
        base["sum_price_w180"] / base["cnt_w180"],
        0.0
    )
    base["avg_price_total"] = np.where(
        base["cnt_total"] > 0,
        base["sum_price_total"] / base["cnt_total"],
        0.0
    )
    # 3. Compute recency and tenure features
    recency_agg = valid_sales.groupby("product_id").agg(
        last_sale=("ts", "max"),
        first_sale=("ts", "min"),
        unique_orders=("order_id", "nunique")
    ).reset_index()
    recency_agg = recency_agg.set_index("product_id")
    base = base.join(recency_agg, how="left")
    # Convert time deltas to days, fill missing with 2 years (730 days)
    base["days_since_last"] = (seed_ts - base["last_sale"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 60 * 60)
    base["days_since_first"] = (seed_ts - base["first_sale"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 60 * 60)
    base[["days_since_last", "days_since_first", "unique_orders"]] = base[
        ["days_since_last", "days_since_first", "unique_orders"]
    ].fillna(730.0)
    base["unique_orders"] = base["unique_orders"].astype(int)
    # Add binary sales flag and average items per order
    base["has_sales"] = (base["cnt_total"] > 0).astype(int)
    base["avg_items_per_order"] = np.where(
        base["unique_orders"] > 0,
        base["cnt_total"] / base["unique_orders"],
        0.0
    )
    # 4. Compute review features
    # Merge reviews with order items to link reviews to products
    review_item = pd.merge(
        reviews_df[["order_id", "review_score", "review_creation_date"]],
        items_df[["order_id", "product_id", "ts"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    # Filter reviews created before seed time
    valid_reviews = review_item[
        (review_item["ts"] < seed_ts) &
        (review_item["review_creation_date"] < seed_ts)
    ].copy()
    # Add window flags based on review creation date
    valid_reviews["rw30"] = (valid_reviews["review_creation_date"] >= window_30) & (valid_reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_ts)
    valid_reviews["rw90"] = (valid_reviews["review_creation_date"] >= window_90) & (valid_reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_ts)
    valid_reviews["rw180"] = (valid_reviews["review_creation_date"] >= window_180) & (valid_reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_ts)
    valid_reviews["rall"] = valid_reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_ts
    # Masked review scores
    valid_reviews["score_w30"] = valid_reviews["review_score"] * valid_reviews["rw30"].astype(float)
    valid_reviews["score_w90"] = valid_reviews["review_score"] * valid_reviews["rw90"].astype(float)
    valid_reviews["score_w180"] = valid_reviews["review_score"] * valid_reviews["rw180"].astype(float)
    # Aggregate review features
    review_agg = valid_reviews.groupby("product_id").agg(
        rev_cnt_w30=("rw30", "sum"),
        rev_cnt_w90=("rw90", "sum"),
        rev_cnt_w180=("rw180", "sum"),
        rev_cnt_total=("rall", "sum"),
        sum_score_w30=("score_w30", "sum"),
        sum_score_w90=("score_w90", "sum"),
        sum_score_w180=("score_w180", "sum"),
        sum_score_total=("review_score", "sum")
    ).reset_index()
    review_agg = review_agg.set_index("product_id")
    base = base.join(review_agg, how="left")
    # Fill missing review values with 0
    rev_cols = ["rev_cnt_w30", "rev_cnt_w90", "rev_cnt_w180", "rev_cnt_total",
                "sum_score_w30", "sum_score_w90", "sum_score_w180", "sum_score_total"]
    base[rev_cols] = base[rev_cols].fillna(0)
    # Compute average review scores
    base["avg_rev_w30"] = np.where(
        base["rev_cnt_w30"] > 0,
        base["sum_score_w30"] / base["rev_cnt_w30"],
        0.0
    )
    base["avg_rev_w90"] = np.where(
        base["rev_cnt_w90"] > 0,
        base["sum_score_w90"] / base["rev_cnt_w90"],
        0.0
    )
    base["avg_rev_w180"] = np.where(
        base["rev_cnt_w180"] > 0,
        base["sum_score_w180"] / base["rev_cnt_w180"],
        0.0
    )
    base["avg_rev_total"] = np.where(
        base["rev_cnt_total"] > 0,
        base["sum_score_total"] / base["rev_cnt_total"],
        0.0
    )
    # 5. Compute seller diversity features
    # Unique sellers per window
    seller_w30 = valid_sales[valid_sales["w30"]].groupby("product_id")["seller_id"].nunique().reset_index(name="sellers_w30")
    seller_w90 = valid_sales[valid_sales["w90"]].groupby("product_id")["seller_id"].nunique().reset_index(name="sellers_w90")
    seller_w180 = valid_sales[valid_sales["w180"]].groupby("product_id")["seller_id"].nunique().reset_index(name="sellers_w180")
    seller_total = valid_sales.groupby("product_id")["seller_id"].nunique().reset_index(name="sellers_total")
    # Merge seller features sequentially
    seller_features = pd.merge(seller_w30, seller_w90, on="product_id", how="outer")
    seller_features = pd.merge(seller_features, seller_w180, on="product_id", how="outer")
    seller_features = pd.merge(seller_features, seller_total, on="product_id", how="outer")
    seller_features = seller_features.set_index("product_id")
    base = base.join(seller_features, how="left")
    # Fill missing seller counts with 0 and convert to integer
    seller_cols = ["sellers_w30", "sellers_w90", "sellers_w180", "sellers_total"]
    base[seller_cols] = base[seller_cols].fillna(0).astype(int)
    # 6. Compute payment behavior features
    # Aggregate payment info per order
    order_pay = payments_df.groupby("order_id").agg(
        avg_install=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        has_install=("payment_installments", lambda x: (x > 1).any()),
        total_pay=("payment_value", "sum")
    ).reset_index()
    # Merge with valid sales
    item_pay = pd.merge(valid_sales, order_pay, on="order_id", how="left")
    # Masked payment values for windowed aggregation
    item_pay["install_w30"] = item_pay["avg_install"] * item_pay["w30"].astype(float)
    item_pay["install_w90"] = item_pay["avg_install"] * item_pay["w90"].astype(float)
    item_pay["install_w180"] = item_pay["avg_install"] * item_pay["w180"].astype(float)
    item_pay["has_install_w30"] = item_pay["has_install"] * item_pay["w30"].astype(float)
    item_pay["has_install_w90"] = item_pay["has_install"] * item_pay["w90"].astype(float)
    item_pay["has_install_w180"] = item_pay["has_install"] * item_pay["w180"].astype(float)
    # Aggregate payment features
    pay_agg = item_pay.groupby("product_id").agg(
        sum_install_w30=("install_w30", "sum"),
        sum_install_w90=("install_w90", "sum"),
        sum_install_w180=("install_w180", "sum"),
        cnt_install_w30=("has_install_w30", "sum"),
        cnt_install_w90=("has_install_w90", "sum"),
        cnt_install_w180=("has_install_w180", "sum")
    ).reset_index()
    pay_agg = pay_agg.set_index("product_id")
    base = base.join(pay_agg, how="left")
    # Fill missing payment values with 0
    pay_cols = ["sum_install_w30", "sum_install_w90", "sum_install_w180",
                "cnt_install_w30", "cnt_install_w90", "cnt_install_w180"]
    base[pay_cols] = base[pay_cols].fillna(0)
    # Compute average installments per window
    base["avg_install_w30"] = np.where(
        base["cnt_w30"] > 0,
        base["sum_install_w30"] / base["cnt_w30"],
        0.0
    )
    base["avg_install_w90"] = np.where(
        base["cnt_w90"] > 0,
        base["sum_install_w90"] / base["cnt_w90"],
        0.0
    )
    base["avg_install_w180"] = np.where(
        base["cnt_w180"] > 0,
        base["sum_install_w180"] / base["cnt_w180"],
        0.0
    )
    # 7. Compute trend/ratio features
    epsilon = 1e-8
    base["trend_w30_w90"] = base["cnt_w30"] / (base["cnt_w90"] + epsilon)
    base["trend_w90_w180"] = base["cnt_w90"] / (base["cnt_w180"] + epsilon)
    base["rev_trend_w30_w90"] = base["rev_w30"] / (base["rev_w90"] + epsilon)
    base["rev_trend_w90_w180"] = base["rev_w90"] / (base["rev_w180"] + epsilon)
    # 8. Clean up final DataFrame
    # Drop non-numeric columns (timestamps)
    numeric_cols = base.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns.tolist()
    final = base[numeric_cols]
    # Reindex to ensure exact match to input entity IDs and fill any remaining NaNs
    final = final.reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    return final

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Extract database tables
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]
    # Define time windows for historical aggregation (name, lookback duration)
    time_windows = [
        ("7d", pd.Timedelta(days=7)),
        ("30d", pd.Timedelta(days=30)),
        ("90d", pd.Timedelta(days=90)),
        ("all_time", pd.Timedelta(days=365 * 10)),  # Covers full dataset history
    ]
    valid_order_statuses = ["delivered", "shipped", "approved", "invoiced", "processing"]
    # Filter order items to valid, pre-seed orders, merge with order metadata
    order_items_valid = order_items[order_items["ts"] < seed_time].merge(
        orders[["order_id", "order_status", "order_delivered_customer_date", "order_estimated_delivery_date"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    order_items_valid = order_items_valid[order_items_valid["order_status"].isin(valid_order_statuses)]
    # Calculate delivery delay in days for delivered orders
    order_items_valid["delivery_delay_days"] = (
        order_items_valid["order_delivered_customer_date"] - order_items_valid["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    features_list = []
    # Generate core order/item features for each time window
    for window_name, time_delta in time_windows:
        lower_bound = seed_time - time_delta
        window_data = order_items_valid[
            (order_items_valid["ts"] >= lower_bound) &
            (order_items_valid["ts"] < seed_time)
        ]
        # Aggregate metrics per product
        agg_funcs = {
            "order_id": ["nunique", "count"],
            "price": ["mean", "sum", "min", "max", "std"],
            "freight_value": ["mean", "sum"],
            "seller_id": ["nunique"],
            "delivery_delay_days": ["mean", "std", "count"],
        }
        window_feats = window_data.groupby("product_id").agg(agg_funcs)
        # Flatten multi-index columns and rename for readability
        window_feats.columns = [f"{col[0]}_{col[1]}" for col in window_feats.columns]
        rename_map = {
            "order_id_nunique": f"count_orders_{window_name}",
            "order_id_count": f"total_units_{window_name}",
            "price_mean": f"avg_price_{window_name}",
            "price_sum": f"total_revenue_{window_name}",
            "price_min": f"min_price_{window_name}",
            "price_max": f"max_price_{window_name}",
            "price_std": f"std_price_{window_name}",
            "freight_value_mean": f"avg_freight_{window_name}",
            "freight_value_sum": f"total_freight_{window_name}",
            "seller_id_nunique": f"unique_sellers_{window_name}",
            "delivery_delay_days_mean": f"avg_delivery_delay_days_{window_name}",
            "delivery_delay_days_std": f"std_delivery_delay_days_{window_name}",
            "delivery_delay_days_count": f"delivered_orders_{window_name}",
        }
        window_feats = window_feats.rename(columns=rename_map)
        features_list.append(window_feats)
    # Prepare and add review features
    reviews_valid = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time]
    reviews_with_products = reviews_valid.merge(
        order_items_valid[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates(),
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    reviews_with_products["has_comment"] = (
        reviews_with_products["review_comment_title"].notna() |
        reviews_with_products["review_comment_message"].notna()
    )
    for window_name, time_delta in time_windows:
        lower_bound = seed_time - time_delta
        window_reviews = reviews_with_products[
            (reviews_with_products["review_creation_date"] >= lower_bound) &
            (reviews_with_products["review_creation_date"] < seed_time)
        ]
        review_agg = window_reviews.groupby("product_id").agg(
            avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
            total_reviews=("review_score", "count"),
            std_review_score=("review_score", "std"),
            count_comments=("has_comment", "sum"),
            pct_comments=("has_comment", "mean")
        )
        review_agg.columns = [f"{col}_{window_name}" for col in review_agg.columns]
        features_list.append(review_agg)
    # Prepare and add payment features
    payments_valid = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time]
    payments_with_products = payments_valid.merge(
        order_items_valid[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates(),
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    for window_name, time_delta in time_windows:
        lower_bound = seed_time - time_delta
        window_payments = payments_with_products[
            (payments_with_products["ts"] >= lower_bound) &
            (payments_with_products["ts"] < seed_time)
        ]
        # Aggregate payment metrics per order first to avoid double-counting
        order_payment_agg = window_payments.groupby("order_id").agg(
            total_order_payment=("payment_value", "sum"),
            avg_order_installments=("payment_installments", "mean")
        )
        order_payment_with_products = order_payment_agg.merge(
            order_items_valid[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates(),
            on="order_id",
            how="inner"
        )
        # Core payment aggregates per product
        payment_agg = order_payment_with_products.groupby("product_id").agg(
            avg_order_value=("total_order_payment", "mean"),
            std_order_value=("total_order_payment", "std"),
            avg_installments=("avg_order_installments", "mean"),
            total_orders_paid=("order_id", "nunique")
        )
        # Payment type distribution
        payment_type_counts = window_payments.groupby(["product_id", "payment_type"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
        payment_type_counts.columns = [f"count_{pt}_{window_name}" for pt in payment_type_counts.columns]
        total_per_product = payment_type_counts.sum(axis=1)
        payment_type_pct = payment_type_counts.div(total_per_product + 1e-8, axis=0).fillna(0)
        payment_type_pct.columns = [f"pct_{pt}_{window_name}" for pt in payment_type_counts.columns]
        # Merge all payment features and rename
        payment_agg = pd.concat([payment_agg, payment_type_counts, payment_type_pct], axis=1)
        rename_payment = {
            "avg_order_value": f"avg_order_value_{window_name}",
            "std_order_value": f"std_order_value_{window_name}",
            "avg_installments": f"avg_installments_{window_name}",
            "total_orders_paid": f"total_orders_paid_{window_name}"
        }
        payment_agg = payment_agg.rename(columns=rename_payment)
        features_list.append(payment_agg)
    # Add recency and lifetime features
    product_timestamps = order_items_valid.groupby("product_id")["ts"].agg(["min", "max"])
    product_timestamps.columns = ["first_order_ts", "last_order_ts"]
    product_timestamps["days_since_first_order"] = (seed_time - product_timestamps["first_order_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    product_timestamps["days_since_last_order"] = (seed_time - product_timestamps["last_order_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    product_timestamps["product_lifetime_days"] = (product_timestamps["last_order_ts"] - product_timestamps["first_order_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    features_list.append(product_timestamps[["days_since_first_order", "days_since_last_order", "product_lifetime_days"]])
    # Merge all features into a single DataFrame
    all_features = pd.concat(features_list, axis=1)
    # Reindex to include all requested entity IDs, fill missing values
    all_features = all_features.reindex(entity_ids)
    # Identify count-based vs numeric columns for targeted filling
    count_keywords = ['count', 'total', 'unique', 'delivered_orders', 'count_']
    count_cols = [col for col in all_features.columns if any(kw in col for kw in count_keywords)]
    numeric_cols = [col for col in all_features.columns if col not in count_cols]
    # Fill missing count data with 0, numeric data with 0 (safe for models to learn missing pattern)
    all_features[count_cols] = all_features[count_cols].fillna(0)
    all_features[numeric_cols] = all_features[numeric_cols].fillna(0)
    # Add history flag
    all_features["has_history"] = (all_features["count_orders_all_time"] > 0).astype(int)
    # Add recency ratio features (recent activity vs total history)
    for window in ["7d", "30d", "90d"]:
        # Avoid division by zero with small epsilon
        denom_orders = all_features["count_orders_all_time"] + 1e-8
        denom_units = all_features["total_units_all_time"] + 1e-8
        denom_rev = all_features["total_revenue_all_time"] + 1e-8
        denom_reviews = all_features["total_reviews_all_time"] + 1e-8
        
        all_features[f"order_ratio_{window}_all"] = all_features[f"count_orders_{window}"] / denom_orders
        all_features[f"unit_ratio_{window}_all"] = all_features[f"total_units_{window}"] / denom_units
        all_features[f"revenue_ratio_{window}_all"] = all_features[f"total_revenue_{window}"] / denom_rev
        all_features[f"review_ratio_{window}_all"] = all_features[f"total_reviews_{window}"] / denom_reviews
    return all_features

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # — подготовка таблиц —
    orders = db["orders"]
    items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # отбираем только заказы до момента предсказания
    items_sel = items[items["ts"] <= seed_time].copy()

    # исключаем отменённые заказы (если есть такой статус)
    order_status = orders[["order_id", "order_status"]].drop_duplicates("order_id")

    items_sel = items_sel[items_sel["order_status"] != "canceled"]
    items_sel = items_sel[items_sel["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)]

    # ---- 1. базовые агрегаты по товарам ----
    base = items_sel.groupby("product_id").agg(
        num_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        num_items=("order_id", "size"),
        total_price=("price", "sum"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        num_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
        last_order_ts=("ts", "max")
    ).reset_index()

    # ---- 2. количество заказов за последние 30/90/180 дней ----
    for days, col_name in [(30, "orders_30d"), (90, "orders_90d"), (180, "orders_180d")]:
        cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=days)
        cnt = items_sel[items_sel["ts"] >= cutoff].groupby("product_id").size().rename(col_name).reset_index()
        base = base.merge(cnt, on="product_id", how="left")
        base[col_name] = base[col_name].fillna(0).astype(int)

    # ---- 3. признаки отзывов (только созданные до seed_time) ----
    reviews_sel = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time]
    items_rev = items_sel[["order_id", "product_id"]].merge(
        reviews_sel[["order_id", "review_score"]], on="order_id", how="inner"
    )
    rev_agg = items_rev.groupby("product_id").agg(
        review_count=("review_score", "count"),
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        pos_review_rate=("review_score", lambda x: (x >= 4).mean())
    ).reset_index()
    base = base.merge(rev_agg, on="product_id", how="left")

    # ---- 4. платежные характеристики (агрегированные по заказу, затем по товару) ----
    pay_order = payments.groupby("order_id").agg(
        payment_sum=("payment_value", "sum"),
        payment_mean=("payment_value", "mean"),
        installments_mean=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        credit_card_share=("payment_type", lambda x: (x == "credit_card").mean())
    ).reset_index()

    items_pay = items_sel[["order_id", "product_id"]].merge(pay_order, on="order_id", how="inner")
    pay_prod = items_pay.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_payment_sum=("payment_sum", "mean"),
        avg_payment_mean=("payment_mean", "mean"),
        avg_installments=("installments_mean", "mean"),
        avg_credit_card_share=("credit_card_share", "mean")
    ).reset_index()
    base = base.merge(pay_prod, on="product_id", how="left")

    # ---- 5. давность последнего заказа ----
    last = pd.to_datetime(base["last_order_ts"])
    recency = (seed_time - last).dt.days
    recency = recency.fillna(999)
    base["recency_days"] = recency
    base = base.drop(columns=["last_order_ts"])

    # ---- финальная реиндексация под переданные product_id ----
    base = base.set_index("product_id")
    result = base.reindex(entity_ids)

    # заполняем пропуски: отзывы/платежи/числа — 0, давность — большое значение
    if "recency_days" in result.columns:
        result["recency_days"] = result["recency_days"].fillna(999)
    result = result.fillna(0)

    return result

def get_features(db, entity_ids, seed_time):
    # Фиксируем список признаков
    windows = [7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180]
    cols = [
        'total_orders', 'total_unique_orders', 'total_sales', 'total_freight',
        'avg_price', 'avg_freight', 'min_price', 'max_price', 'recency_days'
    ]
    for w in windows:
        cols += [
            f'count_last_{w}d',
            f'sum_price_last_{w}d',
            f'sum_freight_last_{w}d',
            f'avg_price_last_{w}d',
            f'avg_freight_last_{w}d'
        ]
    cols += [
        'total_payment_value', 'payment_count', 'avg_installments',
        'credit_card_ratio', 'boleto_ratio',
        'review_count', 'avg_review_score', 'std_review_score', 'high_review_ratio'
    ]

    result = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=entity_ids, columns=cols)

    orders = db['orders']
    items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    # оставляем только нужные товары и покупки до seed_time
    items = items[items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids)]
    items_before = items[items['ts'] < seed_time].copy()

    if items_before.empty:
        return result.astype(float)

    # --- агрегация по всем продажам ---
    agg = items_before.groupby('product_id').agg(
        total_orders=('price', 'count'),
        total_unique_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
        total_sales=('price', 'sum'),
        total_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
        avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
        avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
        min_price=('price', 'min'),
        max_price=('price', 'max'),
        last_ts=('ts', 'max')
    )
    agg['recency_days'] = (seed_time - agg['last_ts']).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
    agg = agg.drop(columns=['last_ts'])

    # --- окна разной длительности ---
    for w in windows:
        mask = items_before['ts'] >= (seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=w))
        if mask.any():
            sub = items_before[mask]
            wagg = sub.groupby('product_id').agg(
                count=('price', 'count'),
                sum_price=('price', 'sum'),
                sum_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
                avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
                avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean')
            ).rename(columns={
                'count': f'count_last_{w}d',
                'sum_price': f'sum_price_last_{w}d',
                'sum_freight': f'sum_freight_last_{w}d',
                'avg_price': f'avg_price_last_{w}d',
                'avg_freight': f'avg_freight_last_{w}d'
            })
            agg = agg.merge(wagg, left_index=True, right_index=True, how='left')

    # --- платежи ---
    # уникальные пары заказ-товар
    item_orders = items_before[['order_id', 'product_id']].drop_duplicates()
    pay = payments[payments['ts'] < seed_time][['order_id', 'payment_type', 'payment_installments', 'payment_value']]
    if len(pay) > 0:
        item_pay = item_orders.merge(pay, on='order_id', how='left')
        pay_agg = item_pay.groupby('product_id').agg(
            total_payment_value=('payment_value', 'sum'),
            payment_count=('payment_value', 'count'),
            avg_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
            credit_card_ratio=('payment_type', lambda x: (x == 'credit_card').mean()),
            boleto_ratio=('payment_type', lambda x: (x == 'boleto').mean())
        )
        agg = agg.merge(pay_agg, left_index=True, right_index=True, how='left')

    # --- отзывы, доступные до seed_time ---
    review_info = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time][['order_id', 'review_score']]
    if len(review_info) > 0:
        item_rev = item_orders.merge(review_info, on='order_id', how='inner')
        if not item_rev.empty:
            rev_agg = item_rev.groupby('product_id').agg(
                review_count=('review_score', 'count'),
                avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
                std_review_score=('review_score', 'std'),
                high_review_ratio=('review_score', lambda x: (x >= 4).mean())
            )
            agg = agg.merge(rev_agg, left_index=True, right_index=True, how='left')

    # переносим посчитанные признаки в result
    result.update(agg)
    result = result.astype(float)
    return result

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Извлекаем таблицы
    orders = db['orders']
    items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']
    
    seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)
    
    # Фильтруем order_items по интересующим товарам
    items_filtered = items[items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids)]
    
    # Соединяем с orders для получения времени и customer_id
    merged = items_filtered.merge(
        orders[['order_id', 'order_purchase_timestamp', 'customer_id']],
        on='order_id',
        how='left'
    )
    
    # Оставляем только заказы до seed_time
    merged = merged[merged['order_purchase_timestamp'] < seed_time]
    
    # Если нет ни одного заказа, сразу возвращаем нулевые признаки
    if merged.empty:
        features = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)
        # Определим список признаков (будет использован и в основном пути)
        feature_cols = [
            'count_orders', 'sum_price', 'sum_freight', 'avg_price', 'avg_freight',
            'count_customers', 'count_sellers', 'last_order_days',
            'avg_days_between_orders', 'count_last_30_days', 'count_last_90_days',
            'had_orders', 'avg_review_score', 'count_reviews', 'neg_review_ratio',
            'avg_payment_installments', 'installments_gt1_ratio',
            'avg_order_size'
        ]
        for col in feature_cols:
            features[col] = 0.0
        return features
    
    # Базовые агрегаты по товарам
    grp = merged.groupby('product_id')
    
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)
    features['count_orders'] = grp['order_id'].nunique()
    features['sum_price'] = grp['price'].sum()
    features['sum_freight'] = grp['freight_value'].sum()
    features['avg_price'] = grp['price'].mean()
    features['avg_freight'] = grp['freight_value'].mean()
    features['count_customers'] = grp['customer_id'].nunique()
    features['count_sellers'] = grp['seller_id'].nunique()
    
    # Время последнего заказа (в днях до seed_time)
    last_order = grp['order_purchase_timestamp'].max()
    features['last_order_days'] = (seed_time - last_order).dt.days
    
    # Средний интервал между заказами
    merged_sorted = merged.sort_values(['product_id', 'order_purchase_timestamp'])
    merged_sorted['prev_time'] = merged_sorted.groupby('product_id')['order_purchase_timestamp'].shift()
    merged_sorted['days_diff'] = (merged_sorted['order_purchase_timestamp'] - merged_sorted['prev_time']).dt.days
    diff_data = merged_sorted.dropna(subset=['days_diff'])
    if not diff_data.empty:
        avg_days = diff_data.groupby('product_id')['days_diff'].mean()
        features['avg_days_between_orders'] = avg_days
    else:
        features['avg_days_between_orders'] = np.nan
    
    # Заказы за последние 30 и 90 дней
    cutoff_30 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    cutoff_90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    merged_30 = merged[merged['order_purchase_timestamp'] >= cutoff_30]
    merged_90 = merged[merged['order_purchase_timestamp'] >= cutoff_90]
    features['count_last_30_days'] = merged_30.groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
    features['count_last_90_days'] = merged_90.groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
    
    # Был ли хотя бы один заказ
    features['had_orders'] = (features['count_orders'] > 0).astype(int)
    
    # Признаки из отзывов (только созданные до seed_time)
    reviews_filtered = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time]
    merged_reviews = merged.merge(
        reviews_filtered[['order_id', 'review_score']],
        on='order_id',
        how='left'
    )
    rev_grp = merged_reviews.groupby('product_id')
    features['avg_review_score'] = rev_grp['review_score'].mean()
    features['count_reviews'] = rev_grp['review_score'].count()  # кол-во не-NaN
    neg_rev = merged_reviews[merged_reviews['review_score'] <= 2]
    neg_counts = neg_rev.groupby('product_id')['review_score'].count()
    # Доля негативных отзывов (по отношению к количеству отзывов)
    features['neg_review_ratio'] = neg_counts / features['count_reviews']
    
    # Признаки из платежей
    merged_pay = merged.merge(
        payments[['order_id', 'payment_installments', 'payment_type']],
        on='order_id',
        how='left'
    )
    pay_grp = merged_pay.groupby('product_id')
    features['avg_payment_installments'] = pay_grp['payment_installments'].mean()
    features['installments_gt1_ratio'] = (merged_pay['payment_installments'] > 1).groupby(merged_pay['product_id']).mean()
    
    # Средний размер заказа (общее количество позиций в заказе)
    order_sizes = items.groupby('order_id').size().rename('order_size')
    merged_sizes = merged.merge(order_sizes, on='order_id', how='left')
    features['avg_order_size'] = merged_sizes.groupby('product_id')['order_size'].mean()
    
    # Реиндексация под все entity_ids и заполнение пропусков
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
    features = features.fillna(0)
    
    # Приводим все столбцы к float
    features = features.astype(float)
    
    return features

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if not isinstance(seed_time, pd.Timestamp):
        seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)
    
    # извлекаем таблицы
    orders = db['orders']
    order_items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']
    
    # --- 1. Исторические заказы до seed_time ---
    orders_hist = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] < seed_time].copy()
    
    if orders_hist.empty:
        # Если нет истории, все признаки будут нулевыми
        num_entities = len(entity_ids)
        features = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)
        # добавим несколько нулевых колонок
        for col in ['num_orders', 'num_sales', 'sum_price', 'avg_price',
                    'median_price', 'sum_freight', 'avg_freight',
                    'num_sellers', 'num_customers', 'recency_days',
                    'orders_last_7_days', 'orders_last_30_days',
                    'orders_last_60_days', 'orders_last_90_days',
                    'orders_last_180_days', 'orders_last_365_days']:
            features[col] = 0
        # в этом случае вернем сразу с нулевыми фичами
        return features.reindex(entity_ids)
    
    # --- 2. Объединяем с order_items для получения продаж по товарам ---
    # используем inner join, т.к. нужны только товары с продажами до seed_time
    sale_events = order_items.merge(
        orders_hist[['order_id', 'customer_id', 'order_status',
                     'order_purchase_timestamp', 'order_delivered_customer_date']],
        on='order_id',
        how='inner'
    )
    
    if sale_events.empty:
        # аналогично, нет данных
        features = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)
        for col in ['num_orders', 'num_sales', 'sum_price', 'avg_price',
                    'median_price', 'sum_freight', 'avg_freight',
                    'num_sellers', 'num_customers', 'recency_days',
                    'orders_last_7_days', 'orders_last_30_days',
                    'orders_last_60_days', 'orders_last_90_days',
                    'orders_last_180_days', 'orders_last_365_days']:
            features[col] = 0
        return features.reindex(entity_ids)
    
    # --- 3. Базовые агрегаты по продажам ---
    sales_agg = sale_events.groupby('product_id').agg(
        num_sales=('order_id', 'count'),
        num_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
        sum_price=('price', 'sum'),
        avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
        median_price=('price', 'median'),
        min_price=('price', 'min'),
        max_price=('price', 'max'),
        sum_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
        avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
        num_sellers=('seller_id', 'nunique'),
        num_customers=('customer_id', 'nunique'),
        last_sale_time=('order_purchase_timestamp', 'max'),
        first_sale_time=('order_purchase_timestamp', 'min'),
    ).reset_index()
    
    # recency и возраст товара в днях
    sales_agg['recency_days'] = (
        seed_time - sales_agg['last_sale_time']
    ).dt.days
    sales_agg['product_age_days'] = (
        seed_time - sales_agg['first_sale_time']
    ).dt.days
    
    # --- 4. Продажи за последние N дней ---
    for days in [7, 30, 60, 90, 180, 365]:
        start = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=days)
        recent = sale_events[sale_events['order_purchase_timestamp'] >= start]
        recent_agg = recent.groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique().reset_index()
        recent_agg.columns = ['product_id', f'orders_last_{days}_days']
        sales_agg = sales_agg.merge(recent_agg, on='product_id', how='left')
        sales_agg[f'orders_last_{days}_days'] = sales_agg[f'orders_last_{days}_days'].fillna(0).astype(int)
    
    # --- 5. Отзывы ---
    reviews_hist = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time]
    if not reviews_hist.empty:
        # связываем отзывы с товарами через order_id
        reviews_sales = sale_events[['order_id', 'product_id']].drop_duplicates().merge(
            reviews_hist[['order_id', 'review_score']],
            on='order_id',
            how='inner'
        )
        if not reviews_sales.empty:
            reviews_agg = reviews_sales.groupby('product_id').agg(
                count_reviews=('review_score', 'count'),
                avg_review=('review_score', 'mean'),
                pos_reviews=('review_score', lambda x: (x >= 4).sum()),
            ).reset_index()
            reviews_agg['pos_review_ratio'] = (
                reviews_agg['pos_reviews'] / reviews_agg['count_reviews']
            )
            reviews_agg = reviews_agg.drop(columns=['pos_reviews'])
            sales_agg = sales_agg.merge(reviews_agg, on='product_id', how='left')
        else:
            sales_agg['count_reviews'] = 0
            sales_agg['avg_review'] = 0
            sales_agg['pos_review_ratio'] = 0
    else:
        sales_agg['count_reviews'] = 0
        sales_agg['avg_review'] = 0
        sales_agg['pos_review_ratio'] = 0
    
    # --- 6. Платежи ---
    payments_hist = payments[payments['ts'] < seed_time]
    if not payments_hist.empty:
        # агрегируем платежи по заказам
        pay_agg_order = payments_hist.groupby('order_id').agg(
            pay_total=('payment_value', 'sum'),
            pay_count=('payment_sequential', 'count'),
            avg_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
            credit_card_payments=('payment_type', lambda x: (x == 'credit_card').sum()),
        ).reset_index()
        pay_agg_order['credit_card_ratio'] = (
            pay_agg_order['credit_card_payments'] / pay_agg_order['pay_count']
        )
        pay_agg_order = pay_agg_order.drop(columns=['credit_card_payments'])
        
        # уникальные пары заказ-товар
        order_product = sale_events[['order_id', 'product_id']].drop_duplicates()
        pay_product = order_product.merge(pay_agg_order, on='order_id', how='left')
        
        if not pay_product.empty:
            pay_agg = pay_product.groupby('product_id').agg(
                avg_pay_total=('pay_total', 'mean'),
                avg_pay_count=('pay_count', 'mean'),
                avg_installments=('avg_installments', 'mean'),
                avg_credit_card_ratio=('credit_card_ratio', 'mean'),
            ).reset_index()
            sales_agg = sales_agg.merge(pay_agg, on='product_id', how='left')
        else:
            for col in ['avg_pay_total', 'avg_pay_count', 'avg_installments', 'avg_credit_card_ratio']:
                sales_agg[col] = 0
    else:
        for col in ['avg_pay_total', 'avg_pay_count', 'avg_installments', 'avg_credit_card_ratio']:
            sales_agg[col] = 0
    
    # --- 7. Дополнительные признаки из заказов ---
    if 'order_delivered_customer_date' in sale_events.columns:
        # средняя длительность доставки (в днях)
        delivery = sale_events.copy()
        delivery['delivery_days'] = (
            delivery['order_delivered_customer_date'] - delivery['order_purchase_timestamp']
        ).dt.days
        # только доставленные
        delivered = delivery[delivery['delivery_days'].notna()]
        if not delivered.empty:
            delivery_agg = delivered.groupby('product_id')['delivery_days'].mean().reset_index()
            delivery_agg.columns = ['product_id', 'avg_delivery_days']
            sales_agg = sales_agg.merge(delivery_agg, on='product_id', how='left')
        else:
            sales_agg['avg_delivery_days'] = 0
        # доля заказов, доставленных до seed_time (по факту)
        if 'order_delivered_customer_date' in sale_events.columns:
            sale_events['delivered_before_seed'] = (
                sale_events['order_delivered_customer_date'] <= seed_time
            ).astype(int)
            delivered_ratio = sale_events.groupby('product_id')['delivered_before_seed'].mean().reset_index()
            delivered_ratio.columns = ['product_id', 'delivered_ratio']
            sales_agg = sales_agg.merge(delivered_ratio, on='product_id', how='left')
        else:
            sales_agg['delivered_ratio'] = 0
        # доля отмененных заказов
        canceled_ratio = sale_events.groupby('product_id').apply(
            lambda x: (x['order_status'] == 'canceled').mean()
        ).reset_index()
        canceled_ratio.columns = ['product_id', 'canceled_ratio']
        sales_agg = sales_agg.merge(canceled_ratio, on='product_id', how='left')
    else:
        sales_agg['avg_delivery_days'] = 0
        sales_agg['delivered_ratio'] = 0
        sales_agg['canceled_ratio'] = 0
    
    # --- 8. Устанавливаем index = product_id ---
    sales_agg = sales_agg.set_index('product_id')
    
    # --- 9. Заполняем пропуски (для товаров с историей, но отсутствующих признаков) ---
    fill_cols = sales_agg.columns.drop(['last_sale_time', 'first_sale_time'], errors='ignore')
    sales_agg[fill_cols] = sales_agg[fill_cols].fillna(0)
    
    # --- 10. Удаляем временные столбцы last_sale_time, first_sale_time ---
    sales_agg = sales_agg.drop(columns=['last_sale_time', 'first_sale_time'], errors='ignore')
    
    # --- 11. Реиндексируем под entity_ids ---
    result = sales_agg.reindex(entity_ids)
    
    # --- 12. Для отсутствующих товаров заполняем нулями ---
    result = result.fillna(0)
    
    return result

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]
    
    seed_ts = pd.to_datetime(seed_time)
    
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)
    features.index.name = "product_id"
    
    historical_order_items = order_items[
        (order_items["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)) & 
        (order_items["ts"] < seed_ts)
    ].copy()
    
    historical_items = pd.merge(
        historical_order_items,
        orders[["order_id", "order_status", "order_delivered_customer_date", "order_estimated_delivery_date"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    
    historical_items["total_revenue"] = historical_items["price"] + historical_items["freight_value"]
    total_revenue = historical_items.groupby("product_id")["total_revenue"].sum().rename("total_revenue")
    features = features.join(total_revenue, how="left").fillna(0)
    
    total_units = historical_items.groupby("product_id").size().rename("total_units")
    features = features.join(total_units, how="left").fillna(0)
    
    avg_price = historical_items.groupby("product_id")["price"].mean().rename("avg_price")
    features = features.join(avg_price, how="left").fillna(0)
    
    avg_freight = historical_items.groupby("product_id")["freight_value"].mean().rename("avg_freight")
    features = features.join(avg_freight, how="left").fillna(0)
    
    unique_orders = historical_items.groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique().rename("unique_orders")
    features = features.join(unique_orders, how="left").fillna(0)
    
    unique_sellers = historical_items.groupby("product_id")["seller_id"].nunique().rename("unique_sellers")
    features = features.join(unique_sellers, how="left").fillna(0)
    
    delivered_items = historical_items[historical_items["order_status"] == "delivered"]
    delivered_count = delivered_items.groupby("product_id").size().rename("delivered_units")
    features = features.join(delivered_count, how="left").fillna(0)
    features["delivered_share"] = features["delivered_units"] / features["total_units"].replace(0, 1)
    features = features.drop(columns=["delivered_units"])
    
    historical_items["delivery_difference_days"] = (
        historical_items["order_delivered_customer_date"] - historical_items["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    avg_delivery_diff = historical_items.groupby("product_id")["delivery_difference_days"].mean().rename("avg_delivery_diff_days")
    features = features.join(avg_delivery_diff, how="left").fillna(0)
    
    last_sale = historical_items.groupby("product_id")["ts"].max().rename("last_sale_ts")
    features = features.join(last_sale, how="left")
    features["days_since_last_sale"] = (seed_ts - features["last_sale_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    features["days_since_last_sale"] = features["days_since_last_sale"].fillna(730)
    features = features.drop(columns=["last_sale_ts"])
    
    relevant_order_ids = order_items[order_items["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)]["order_id"].unique()
    relevant_reviews = pd.merge(
        reviews[reviews["order_id"].isin(relevant_order_ids)],
        order_items[["order_id", "product_id"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    historical_reviews = relevant_reviews[relevant_reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_ts]
    
    avg_review_score = historical_reviews.groupby("product_id")["review_score"].mean().rename("avg_review_score")
    features = features.join(avg_review_score, how="left").fillna(0)
    
    review_count = historical_reviews.groupby("product_id").size().rename("review_count")
    features = features.join(review_count, how="left").fillna(0)
    
    high_score_reviews = historical_reviews[historical_reviews["review_score"] == 5]
    high_score_count = high_score_reviews.groupby("product_id").size().rename("high_score_reviews")
    features = features.join(high_score_count, how="left").fillna(0)
    features["high_score_share"] = features["high_score_reviews"] / features["review_count"].replace(0, 1)
    features = features.drop(columns=["high_score_reviews"])
    
    relevant_payments = pd.merge(
        payments[payments["order_id"].isin(relevant_order_ids)],
        order_items[["order_id", "product_id"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    historical_payments = relevant_payments[relevant_payments["ts"] < seed_ts]
    
    payments_per_order = historical_payments.groupby(["product_id", "order_id"])["payment_sequential"].max().rename("payments_count")
    avg_payments_per_order = payments_per_order.groupby("product_id").mean().rename("avg_payments_per_order")
    features = features.join(avg_payments_per_order, how="left").fillna(0)
    
    card_payments = historical_payments[historical_payments["payment_type"] == "credit_card"]
    total_payment_value = historical_payments.groupby("product_id")["payment_value"].sum().rename("total_payment_value")
    card_payment_value = card_payments.groupby("product_id")["payment_value"].sum().rename("card_payment_value")
    features = features.join(total_payment_value, how="left").fillna(0)
    features = features.join(card_payment_value, how="left").fillna(0)
    features["card_payment_share"] = features["card_payment_value"] / features["total_payment_value"].replace(0, 1)
    features = features.drop(columns=["total_payment_value", "card_payment_value"])
    
    avg_installments = historical_payments.groupby("product_id")["payment_installments"].mean().rename("avg_installments")
    features = features.join(avg_installments, how="left").fillna(0)
    
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
    features.index.name = "product_id"
    
    return features

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Extract database tables
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]
    
    # Define time windows relative to seed_time
    max_time = seed_time
    t30 = max_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    t90 = max_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    t365 = max_time - pd.Timedelta(days=365)
    
    # Filter order_items to historical data only (before or at seed_time)
    oi_hist = order_items[order_items["ts"] <= max_time].copy()
    
    # Create base index dataframe to preserve all entity_ids (including duplicates)
    entity_index = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)
    entity_index.index.name = "product_id"
    
    # --------------------------
    # 1. Order Items Base Features
    # --------------------------
    # All-time aggregations
    oi_all = oi_hist.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_alltime=("order_id", "count"),
        total_revenue_alltime=("price", "sum"),
        total_freight_alltime=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_price_alltime=("price", "mean"),
        unique_orders_alltime=("order_id", "nunique"),
        unique_sellers_alltime=("seller_id", "nunique"),
        last_sale_ts=("ts", "max"),
        first_sale_ts=("ts", "min")
    ).reset_index().set_index("product_id")
    
    # 30-day window aggregations
    oi_30 = oi_hist[oi_hist["ts"] >= t30].groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_30d=("order_id", "count"),
        total_revenue_30d=("price", "sum"),
        total_freight_30d=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_price_30d=("price", "mean"),
        unique_orders_30d=("order_id", "nunique"),
        unique_sellers_30d=("seller_id", "nunique")
    ).reset_index().set_index("product_id")
    
    # 90-day window aggregations
    oi_90 = oi_hist[oi_hist["ts"] >= t90].groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_90d=("order_id", "count"),
        total_revenue_90d=("price", "sum"),
        total_freight_90d=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_price_90d=("price", "mean"),
        unique_orders_90d=("order_id", "nunique"),
        unique_sellers_90d=("seller_id", "nunique")
    ).reset_index().set_index("product_id")
    
    # 365-day window aggregations
    oi_365 = oi_hist[oi_hist["ts"] >= t365].groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_365d=("order_id", "count"),
        total_revenue_365d=("price", "sum"),
