        total_freight_365d=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_price_365d=("price", "mean"),
        unique_orders_365d=("order_id", "nunique"),
        unique_sellers_365d=("seller_id", "nunique")
    ).reset_index().set_index("product_id")
    
    # Time-based derived features
    oi_time_features = oi_all[["last_sale_ts", "first_sale_ts"]].copy()
    oi_time_features["days_since_last_sale"] = (max_time - oi_time_features["last_sale_ts"]).dt.days
    oi_time_features["days_since_first_sale"] = (max_time - oi_time_features["first_sale_ts"]).dt.days
    oi_time_features["has_any_sales"] = (~oi_time_features["last_sale_ts"].isna()).astype(int)
    oi_time_features["sales_frequency_alltime"] = oi_all["total_units_alltime"] / np.where(
        oi_time_features["days_since_first_sale"] > 0,
        oi_time_features["days_since_first_sale"],
        1
    )
    oi_time_features = oi_time_features.drop(columns=["last_sale_ts", "first_sale_ts"])
    
    # Merge all order items features into base index
    features = entity_index.join(oi_all.drop(columns=["last_sale_ts", "first_sale_ts"]), how="left")
    features = features.join(oi_30, how="left")
    features = features.join(oi_90, how="left")
    features = features.join(oi_365, how="left")
    features = features.join(oi_time_features, how="left")
    
    # Fill NaN values for order items features
    count_sum_cols = [c for c in features.columns if c.startswith("total_") or c.startswith("unique_")]
    mean_cols = [c for c in features.columns if c.startswith("avg_")]
    time_cols = ["days_since_last_sale", "days_since_first_sale"]
    freq_col = "sales_frequency_alltime"
    flag_col = "has_any_sales"
    
    features[count_sum_cols] = features[count_sum_cols].fillna(0)
    features[mean_cols] = features[mean_cols].fillna(0)
    features[time_cols] = features[time_cols].fillna(9999)
    features[freq_col] = features[freq_col].fillna(0)
    features[flag_col] = features[flag_col].fillna(0).astype(int)
    
    # --------------------------
    # 2. Order Status Features
    # --------------------------
    # Link order items to order statuses
    oi_order_status = oi_hist[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates().merge(
        orders[["order_id", "order_status"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    
    # Count order statuses per product
    order_status_counts = oi_order_status.groupby(["product_id", "order_status"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
    order_status_counts.columns = [f"order_status_{col.lower()}" for col in order_status_counts.columns]
    
    # Compute order status ratios
    order_status_totals = order_status_counts.sum(axis=1).rename("total_orders_status")
    order_status_ratios = order_status_counts.div(order_status_totals, axis=0).fillna(0)
    order_status_ratios.columns = [f"{col}_ratio" for col in order_status_ratios.columns]
    
    # Merge order status features
    order_status_features = pd.concat([order_status_counts, order_status_ratios], axis=1)
    features = features.join(order_status_features, how="left")
    status_cols = list(order_status_features.columns)
    features[status_cols] = features[status_cols].fillna(0)
    
    # --------------------------
    # 3. Review Features
    # --------------------------
    # Filter historical reviews (before seed time)
    valid_reviews = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time].copy()
    # Link reviews to products
    review_product = valid_reviews.merge(
        oi_hist[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates(),
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    
    # Aggregate review metrics per product
    review_agg = review_product.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_reviews=("review_id", "count"),
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        min_review_score=("review_score", "min"),
        max_review_score=("review_score", "max"),
        total_comments=("review_comment_title", lambda x: (
            ~x.isna() | ~review_product.loc[x.index, "review_comment_message"].isna()
        ).sum()),
        last_review_ts=("review_creation_date", "max")
    ).reset_index().set_index("product_id")
    
    review_agg["days_since_last_review"] = (max_time - review_agg["last_review_ts"]).dt.days
    
    # Count review scores per product
    review_score_counts = review_product.groupby(["product_id", "review_score"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
    for score in range(1, 6):
        if score not in review_score_counts.columns:
            review_score_counts[score] = 0
    review_score_counts = review_score_counts[[1,2,3,4,5]]
    review_score_counts.columns = [f"review_score_{s}" for s in range(1,6)]
    
    # Compute review score ratios
    review_score_totals = review_score_counts.sum(axis=1)
    review_score_ratios = review_score_counts.div(review_score_totals, axis=0).fillna(0)
    review_score_ratios.columns = [f"{col}_ratio" for col in review_score_ratios.columns]
    
    # Combine review features
    review_features = pd.concat([review_agg.drop(columns=["last_review_ts"]), review_score_counts, review_score_ratios], axis=1)
    review_features["has_reviews"] = (review_features["total_reviews"] > 0).astype(int)
    
    # Merge review features
    features = features.join(review_features, how="left")
    review_fill_cols = [c for c in review_features.columns if c!= "days_since_last_review"]
    features[review_fill_cols] = features[review_fill_cols].fillna(0)
    features["days_since_last_review"] = features["days_since_last_review"].fillna(9999)
    
    # --------------------------
    # 4. Payment Features
    # --------------------------
    # Filter historical payments (before seed time)
    valid_payments = payments[payments["ts"] <= seed_time].copy()
    
    # Aggregate payments per order
    order_payments_agg = valid_payments.groupby("order_id").agg(
        total_payment_value=("payment_value", "sum"),
        avg_payment_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        num_payment_sequentials=("payment_sequential", "nunique")
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Count payment types per order
    order_payment_types = valid_payments.groupby(["order_id", "payment_type"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
    order_payment_types.columns = [f"payment_type_{col.lower()}" for col in order_payment_types.columns]
    
    # Combine order-level payment features
    order_payment_features = pd.concat([
        order_payments_agg.set_index("order_id"),
        order_payment_types
    ], axis=1).reset_index()
    
    # Link payment features to products
    product_payment = oi_hist[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates().merge(
        order_payment_features,
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    
    # Aggregate payment features per product
    payment_agg = product_payment.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_total_payment_per_order=("total_payment_value", "mean"),
        avg_payment_installments=("avg_payment_installments", "mean"),
        total_orders_with_payments=("order_id", "nunique")
    ).reset_index().set_index("product_id")
    
    # Sum payment type counts per product
    payment_type_cols = list(order_payment_types.columns)
    payment_type_sums = product_payment.groupby("product_id")[payment_type_cols].sum()
    payment_type_sums.columns = [f"total_{col}" for col in payment_type_sums.columns]
    
    # Compute payment type ratios
    payment_type_totals = payment_type_sums.sum(axis=1)
    payment_type_ratios = payment_type_sums.div(payment_type_totals, axis=0).fillna(0)
    payment_type_ratios.columns = [f"{col}_ratio" for col in payment_type_ratios.columns]
    
    # Combine payment features
    payment_features = pd.concat([payment_agg, payment_type_sums, payment_type_ratios], axis=1)
    payment_features["has_payments"] = (payment_features["total_orders_with_payments"] > 0).astype(int)
    
    # Merge payment features
    features = features.join(payment_features, how="left")
    payment_fill_cols = list(payment_features.columns)
    features[payment_fill_cols] = features[payment_fill_cols].fillna(0)
    
    # --------------------------
    # 5. Derived Trend/Interaction Features
    # --------------------------
    # Unit sales ratios
    features["ratio_30d_to_90d_units"] = np.where(
        features["total_units_90d"] > 0,
        features["total_units_30d"] / features["total_units_90d"],
        0
    )
    features["ratio_30d_to_365d_units"] = np.where(
        features["total_units_365d"] > 0,
        features["total_units_30d"] / features["total_units_365d"],
        0
    )
    features["ratio_90d_to_365d_units"] = np.where(
        features["total_units_365d"] > 0,
        features["total_units_90d"] / features["total_units_365d"],
        0
    )
    
    # Revenue ratios
    features["ratio_30d_to_90d_revenue"] = np.where(
        features["total_revenue_90d"] > 0,
        features["total_revenue_30d"] / features["total_revenue_90d"],
        0
    )
    features["ratio_30d_to_365d_revenue"] = np.where(
        features["total_revenue_365d"] > 0,
        features["total_revenue_30d"] / features["total_revenue_365d"],
        0
    )
    features["ratio_90d_to_365d_revenue"] = np.where(
        features["total_revenue_365d"] > 0,
        features["total_revenue_90d"] / features["total_revenue_365d"],
        0
    )
    
    # Average units per order
    features["avg_units_per_order_alltime"] = np.where(
        features["unique_orders_alltime"] > 0,
        features["total_units_alltime"] / features["unique_orders_alltime"],
        0
    )
    features["avg_units_per_order_30d"] = np.where(
        features["unique_orders_30d"] > 0,
        features["total_units_30d"] / features["unique_orders_30d"],
        0
    )
    features["avg_units_per_order_90d"] = np.where(
        features["unique_orders_90d"] > 0,
        features["total_units_90d"] / features["unique_orders_90d"],
        0
    )
    features["avg_units_per_order_365d"] = np.where(
        features["unique_orders_365d"] > 0,
        features["total_units_365d"] / features["unique_orders_365d"],
        0
    )
    
    # Ensure index matches input entity_ids (preserves order and duplicates)
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
    features.index.name = "product_id"
    
    return features

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Extract tables from database
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # Filter all data to be strictly before seed_time (no future leakage)
    historical_items = order_items[order_items["ts"] < seed_time].copy()
    historical_reviews = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time].copy()
    historical_payments = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time].copy()

    # --------------------------
    # 1. Aggregate order_items features
    # --------------------------
    item_aggs = historical_items.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units=pd.NamedAgg(column="order_item_id", aggfunc="count"),
        total_revenue=pd.NamedAgg(column="price", aggfunc="sum"),
        total_freight=pd.NamedAgg(column="freight_value", aggfunc="sum"),
        avg_price=pd.NamedAgg(column="price", aggfunc="mean"),
        avg_freight=pd.NamedAgg(column="freight_value", aggfunc="mean"),
        unique_orders=pd.NamedAgg(column="order_id", aggfunc="nunique"),
        unique_sellers=pd.NamedAgg(column="seller_id", aggfunc="nunique"),
        last_sale_ts=pd.NamedAgg(column="ts", aggfunc="max"),
        first_sale_ts=pd.NamedAgg(column="ts", aggfunc="min")
    ).reset_index()

    # Add time-based features (avoid 0 days for division)
    item_aggs["days_since_last_sale"] = (seed_time - item_aggs["last_sale_ts"]).dt.days.replace(0, 1)
    item_aggs["days_since_first_sale"] = (seed_time - item_aggs["first_sale_ts"]).dt.days.replace(0, 1)
    # Add derived frequency/size features
    item_aggs["sales_frequency"] = item_aggs["total_units"] / item_aggs["days_since_first_sale"]
    item_aggs["avg_order_size"] = item_aggs["total_units"] / item_aggs["unique_orders"].replace(0, 1)
    # Drop timestamp columns (no longer needed as features)
    item_aggs.drop(columns=["last_sale_ts", "first_sale_ts"], inplace=True)

    # --------------------------
    # 2. Aggregate order status features
    # --------------------------
    # Link items to order statuses
    order_status = historical_items[["order_id", "product_id"]].merge(
        orders[["order_id", "order_status"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    # Pivot status counts to features
    status_aggs = order_status.groupby("product_id")["order_status"].value_counts().unstack(fill_value=0)
    status_aggs.columns = [f"status_{col.lower()}" for col in status_aggs.columns]
    status_aggs.reset_index(inplace=True)

    # --------------------------
    # 3. Aggregate review features
    # --------------------------
    # Link items to reviews (only valid historical reviews)
    product_orders = historical_items[["order_id", "product_id"]]
    product_reviews = product_orders.merge(
        historical_reviews[["order_id", "review_score"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    # Aggregate review metrics
    review_aggs = product_reviews.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_reviews=pd.NamedAgg(column="review_score", aggfunc="count"),
        avg_review_score=pd.NamedAgg(column="review_score", aggfunc="mean"),
        five_star_reviews=pd.NamedAgg(column="review_score", aggfunc=lambda x: (x == 5).sum()),
        one_star_reviews=pd.NamedAgg(column="review_score", aggfunc=lambda x: (x == 1).sum())
    ).reset_index()
    # Add review fractions (avoid division by zero)
    review_aggs["five_star_fraction"] = review_aggs["five_star_reviews"] / review_aggs["total_reviews"].replace(0, 1)
    review_aggs["one_star_fraction"] = review_aggs["one_star_reviews"] / review_aggs["total_reviews"].replace(0, 1)

    # --------------------------
    # 4. Aggregate payment features
    # --------------------------
    # Link items to payments (only valid historical payments)
    product_payments = product_orders.merge(
        historical_payments[["order_id", "payment_value", "payment_installments", "payment_type"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    # Aggregate numeric payment metrics
    payment_aggs = product_payments.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_payment_value=pd.NamedAgg(column="payment_value", aggfunc="mean"),
        total_payment_value=pd.NamedAgg(column="payment_value", aggfunc="sum"),
        avg_installments=pd.NamedAgg(column="payment_installments", aggfunc="mean"),
        max_installments=pd.NamedAgg(column="payment_installments", aggfunc="max"),
        min_installments=pd.NamedAgg(column="payment_installments", aggfunc="min")
    ).reset_index()
    # Pivot payment type counts to features
    payment_type_aggs = product_payments.groupby("product_id")["payment_type"].value_counts().unstack(fill_value=0)
    payment_type_aggs.columns = [f"payment_{col.lower()}" for col in payment_type_aggs.columns]
    payment_type_aggs.reset_index(inplace=True)

    # --------------------------
    # Merge all features, clean, and reindex to target entity_ids
    # --------------------------
    all_feature_dfs = [item_aggs, status_aggs, review_aggs, payment_aggs, payment_type_aggs]

    # Merge all feature dataframes on product_id
    merged_features = item_aggs
    for feat_df in all_feature_dfs[1:]:
        merged_features = merged_features.merge(feat_df, on="product_id", how="outer")

    # Set product_id as index, reindex to target entity_ids, fill missing with 0
    merged_features.set_index("product_id", inplace=True)
    final_features = merged_features.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0)
    # Ensure all values are numeric and fill any remaining NaNs
    final_features = final_features.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0)

    return final_features

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Create base DataFrame indexed by requested entity IDs to ensure all are included
    base = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)
    base.index.name = "product_id"
    
    # --------------------------
    # 1. Preprocess core sales data (order_items + orders)
    # --------------------------
    order_items = db["order_items"].copy()
    orders = db["orders"].copy()
    
    # Filter to strictly historical data (before seed_time)
    order_items = order_items[order_items["ts"] < seed_time].copy()
    
    # Merge with orders to get order status
    items_with_orders = pd.merge(
        order_items,
        orders[["order_id", "order_status"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    # Calculate total item value (price + freight)
    items_with_orders["item_total"] = items_with_orders["price"] + items_with_orders["freight_value"]
    
    # Define time windows for feature aggregation (name, lookback_days)
    time_windows = [
        ("7d", 7),
        ("30d", 30),
        ("90d", 90),
        ("365d", 365),
        ("lifetime", None)  # None = all historical data
    ]
    
    # List to collect all feature DataFrames for merging
    all_features = []
    
    # --------------------------
    # 2. Core sales features per time window
    # --------------------------
    for window_name, days in time_windows:
        # Create mask for current time window
        if days is not None:
            cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=days)
            mask = items_with_orders["ts"] >= cutoff
        else:
            mask = pd.Series(True, index=items_with_orders.index)
        
        window_items = items_with_orders[mask].copy()
        
        # Define aggregation functions
        agg_funcs = {
            "order_id": ["nunique", "count"],  # Unique orders, total items sold
            "item_total": ["sum", "mean", "median"],
            "price": ["mean", "median"],
            "freight_value": ["mean", "median"],
            "seller_id": "nunique"
        }
        
        # Group by product and aggregate
        window_features = window_items.groupby("product_id").agg(agg_funcs)
        # Flatten multi-level column names
        window_features.columns = [
            f"{col[0]}_{col[1]}_{window_name}" if col[1] else f"{col[0]}_{window_name}"
            for col in window_features.columns
        ]
        # Rename to human-readable names
        window_features = window_features.rename(columns={
            f"order_id_nunique_{window_name}": f"num_orders_{window_name}",
            f"order_id_count_{window_name}": f"num_items_sold_{window_name}",
            f"item_total_sum_{window_name}": f"total_revenue_{window_name}",
            f"item_total_mean_{window_name}": f"avg_item_total_{window_name}",
            f"item_total_median_{window_name}": f"med_item_total_{window_name}",
            f"price_mean_{window_name}": f"avg_price_{window_name}",
            f"price_median_{window_name}": f"med_price_{window_name}",
            f"freight_value_mean_{window_name}": f"avg_freight_{window_name}",
            f"freight_value_median_{window_name}": f"med_freight_{window_name}",
            f"seller_id_nunique_{window_name}": f"num_sellers_{window_name}"
        })
        
        all_features.append(window_features)
    
    # --------------------------
    # 3. Temporal features (recency, time on market)
    # --------------------------
    sale_timestamps = items_with_orders.groupby("product_id")["ts"].agg(["max", "min"]).reset_index()
    sale_timestamps.columns = ["product_id", "last_sale_ts", "first_sale_ts"]
    sale_timestamps["recency_days"] = (seed_time - sale_timestamps["last_sale_ts"]).dt.days
    sale_timestamps["days_on_market"] = (seed_time - sale_timestamps["first_sale_ts"]).dt.days
    sale_timestamps = sale_timestamps.set_index("product_id")[["recency_days", "days_on_market"]]
    all_features.append(sale_timestamps)
    
    # --------------------------
    # 4. Order status features (cancellation, delivery counts)
    # --------------------------
    status_counts = pd.crosstab(items_with_orders["product_id"], items_with_orders["order_status"])
    status_counts.columns = [f"num_{s}_items" for s in status_counts.columns]
    all_features.append(status_counts)
    
    # --------------------------
    # 5. Review features (product quality proxy)
    # --------------------------
    reviews = db["reviews"].copy()
    # Filter to historical reviews only
    reviews = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time].copy()
    # Link reviews to products via order_items
    order_product_links = order_items[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates()
    reviews_with_products = pd.merge(reviews, order_product_links, on="order_id", how="inner")
    
    for window_name, days in time_windows:
        if days is not None:
            cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=days)
            mask = reviews_with_products["review_creation_date"] >= cutoff
        else:
            mask = pd.Series(True, index=reviews_with_products.index)
        
        window_reviews = reviews_with_products[mask].copy()
        review_agg = window_reviews.groupby("product_id").agg(
            avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
            med_review_score=("review_score", "median"),
            num_reviews=("review_id", "nunique"),
            share_5star=("review_score", lambda x: (x == 5).sum() / len(x) if len(x) > 0 else 0.0),
            share_1star=("review_score", lambda x: (x == 1).sum() / len(x) if len(x) > 0 else 0.0)
        )
        review_agg.columns = [f"{col}_{window_name}" for col in review_agg.columns]
        all_features.append(review_agg)
    
    # --------------------------
    # 6. Payment features (customer behavior proxy)
    # --------------------------
    payments = db["payments"].copy()
    # Filter to historical payments only
    payments = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time].copy()
    # Link payments to products via order_items
    payments_with_products = pd.merge(payments, order_product_links, on="order_id", how="inner")
    
    for window_name, days in time_windows:
        if days is not None:
            cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=days)
            mask = payments_with_products["ts"] >= cutoff
        else:
            mask = pd.Series(True, index=payments_with_products.index)
        
        window_payments = payments_with_products[mask].copy()
        payment_agg = window_payments.groupby("product_id").agg(
            total_payment_value=("payment_value", "sum"),
            avg_payment_value=("payment_value", "mean"),
            med_payment_value=("payment_value", "median"),
            avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
            num_payments=("payment_sequential", "nunique"),
            num_payment_types=("payment_type", "nunique")
        )
        payment_agg.columns = [f"{col}_{window_name}" for col in payment_agg.columns]
        all_features.append(payment_agg)
    
    # Add payment type distribution features
    payment_type_counts = pd.crosstab(payments_with_products["product_id"], payments_with_products["payment_type"])
    payment_type_counts.columns = [f"num_{pt}_payments" for pt in payment_type_counts.columns]
    all_features.append(payment_type_counts)
    
    # --------------------------
    # 7. Finalize feature matrix
    # --------------------------
    # Combine all features into single DataFrame
    if all_features:
        combined = pd.concat(all_features, axis=1, join="outer")
        # Reindex to match requested entity IDs exactly
        final_features = combined.reindex(base.index)
    else:
        # Edge case: no data available, return empty DataFrame with constant
        final_features = base.copy()
        final_features["constant"] = 0
    
    # Handle missing values
    # Assign large recency for products never sold, -1 for days on market
    if "recency_days" in final_features.columns:
        final_features["recency_days"] = final_features["recency_days"].fillna(99999)
    if "days_on_market" in final_features.columns:
        final_features["days_on_market"] = final_features["days_on_market"].fillna(-1)
    # Fill all other missing values with 0 (no activity)
    final_features = final_features.fillna(0)
    # Ensure all columns are numeric
    final_features = final_features.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0)
    
    return final_features

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Создаем базовый датафрейм с нужным индексом (включая дубликаты в entity_ids)
    base = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)
    base.index.name = 'product_id'
    
    # Извлекаем таблицы из базы
    orders = db['orders']
    order_items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']
    
    # Определяем временные окна
    t90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    t30 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    
    # Фильтруем данные по времени покупки (до seed_time)
    oi_valid = order_items[order_items['ts'] <= seed_time].copy()
    oi_90 = oi_valid[oi_valid['ts'] >= t90].copy()
    oi_30 = oi_valid[oi_valid['ts'] >= t30].copy()
    
    # Агрегации по всем историческим данным для товаров
    agg_lifetime = oi_valid.groupby('product_id').agg(
        lifetime_units=('order_item_id', 'count'),
        lifetime_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
        lifetime_avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
        lifetime_avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
        lifetime_last_purchase_days=('ts', lambda x: (seed_time - x.max()).days if x.notna().any() else np.nan),
        lifetime_first_purchase_days=('ts', lambda x: (seed_time - x.min()).days if x.notna().any() else np.nan)
    )
    
    # Агрегации за последние 90 дней
    agg_90 = oi_90.groupby('product_id').agg(
        r90_units=('order_item_id', 'count'),
        r90_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
        r90_avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
        r90_avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
        r90_purchase_freq=('order_item_id', lambda x: len(x)/90)
    )
    
    # Агрегации за последние 30 дней
    agg_30 = oi_30.groupby('product_id').agg(
        r30_units=('order_item_id', 'count'),
        r30_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
        r30_avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
        r30_purchase_freq=('order_item_id', lambda x: len(x)/30)
    )
    
    # Связываем отзывы с товарами через заказы
    order_product = order_items[['order_id', 'product_id']].drop_duplicates()
    rv_merged = reviews.merge(order_product, on='order_id', how='inner')
    rv_valid = rv_merged[rv_merged['review_creation_date'] <= seed_time].copy()
    rv_90 = rv_valid[rv_valid['review_creation_date'] >= t90].copy()
    
    # Агрегации по отзывам за всё время
    agg_reviews_lifetime = rv_valid.groupby('product_id').agg(
        lifetime_reviews=('review_id', 'count'),
        lifetime_avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
        lifetime_last_review_days=('review_creation_date', lambda x: (seed_time - x.max()).days if x.notna().any() else np.nan)
    )
    
    # Агрегации по отзывам за последние 90 дней
    agg_reviews_90 = rv_90.groupby('product_id').agg(
        r90_reviews=('review_id', 'count'),
        r90_avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean')
    )
    
    # Связываем платежи с товарами через заказы
    pay_merged = payments.merge(order_product, on='order_id', how='inner')
    # Оставляем только платежи для заказов, совершённых до seed_time
    valid_order_ids = oi_valid['order_id'].unique()
    pay_valid = pay_merged[pay_merged['order_id'].isin(valid_order_ids)].copy()
    r90_order_ids = oi_90['order_id'].unique()
    pay_90 = pay_valid[pay_valid['order_id'].isin(r90_order_ids)].copy()
    
    # Агрегации по платежам за всё время
    agg_pay_lifetime = pay_valid.groupby('product_id').agg(
        lifetime_total_payment_value=('payment_value', 'sum'),
        lifetime_avg_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
        lifetime_pct_credit_card=('payment_type', lambda x: (x == 'credit_card').mean() * 100),
        lifetime_pct_boleto=('payment_type', lambda x: (x == 'boleto').mean() * 100)
    )
    
    # Агрегации по платежам за последние 90 дней
    agg_pay_90 = pay_90.groupby('product_id').agg(
        r90_total_payment_value=('payment_value', 'sum'),
        r90_avg_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean')
    )
    
    # Объединяем все агрегации с базовым датафреймом
    features = base.join(agg_lifetime, how='left')
    features = features.join(agg_90, how='left')
    features = features.join(agg_30, how='left')
    features = features.join(agg_reviews_lifetime, how='left')
    features = features.join(agg_reviews_90, how='left')
    features = features.join(agg_pay_lifetime, how='left')
    features = features.join(agg_pay_90, how='left')
    
    # Добавляем флаг наличия исторических данных
    features['has_history'] = (~features['lifetime_units'].isna()).astype(np.int32)
    
    # Заполняем пропуски для количественных и средних значений нулями
    fill_zero_cols = [
        'lifetime_units', 'lifetime_orders', 'lifetime_avg_price', 'lifetime_avg_freight',
        'r90_units', 'r90_orders', 'r90_avg_price', 'r90_avg_freight', 'r90_purchase_freq',
        'r30_units', 'r30_orders', 'r30_avg_price', 'r30_purchase_freq',
        'lifetime_reviews', 'lifetime_avg_review_score',
        'r90_reviews', 'r90_avg_review_score',
        'lifetime_total_payment_value', 'lifetime_avg_installments',
        'lifetime_pct_credit_card', 'lifetime_pct_boleto',
        'r90_total_payment_value', 'r90_avg_installments'
    ]
    features[fill_zero_cols] = features[fill_zero_cols].fillna(0)
    
    # Заполняем пропуски для временных признаков большим значением (2 года = 730 дней)
    fill_large_cols = [
        'lifetime_last_purchase_days',
        'lifetime_first_purchase_days',
        'lifetime_last_review_days'
    ]
    features[fill_large_cols] = features[fill_large_cols].fillna(730)
    
    # Добавляем расчётные признаки
    # Отношение продаж за 90 дней ко всем историческим
    features['r90_to_lifetime_ratio'] = np.where(
        features['lifetime_units'] == 0,
        0.0,
        features['r90_units'] / features['lifetime_units']
    )
    
    # Отношение продаж за 30 дней к продажам за 90 дней
    features['r30_to_r90_ratio'] = np.where(
        features['r90_units'] == 0,
        0.0,
        features['r30_units'] / features['r90_units']
    )
    
    # Средний размер заказа (товаров на один заказ)
    features['avg_order_size'] = np.where(
        features['lifetime_orders'] == 0,
        0.0,
        features['lifetime_units'] / features['lifetime_orders']
    )
    
    # Реиндексируем под строго заданный список entity_ids (с сохранением порядка и дубликатов)
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
    features.index.name = 'product_id'
    
    return features

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Create base DataFrame indexed by input entity IDs to ensure full coverage
    base = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)
    
    # Step 1: Filter all tables to exclude data after seed_time (no leakage)
    # Filter orders first, get valid (non-canceled) order IDs to clean all tables
    orders = db["orders"].loc[db["orders"]["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time].copy()
    valid_statuses = ['delivered', 'invoiced', 'shipped', 'processing', 'approved', 'created']
    valid_order_ids = orders.loc[orders["order_status"].isin(valid_statuses), "order_id"].unique()
    
    # Filter core tables to valid orders and pre-seed time data
    order_items = db["order_items"].loc[
        (db["order_items"]["ts"] < seed_time) &
        (db["order_items"]["order_id"].isin(valid_order_ids))
    ].copy()
    reviews = db["reviews"].loc[
        (db["reviews"]["review_creation_date"] < seed_time) &
        (db["reviews"]["order_id"].isin(valid_order_ids))
    ].copy()
    payments = db["payments"].loc[
        (db["payments"]["ts"] < seed_time) &
        (db["payments"]["order_id"].isin(valid_order_ids))
    ].copy()
    
    # Initialize features DataFrame with all expected columns (handle empty order_items case)
    all_feature_cols = [
        "total_units_sold", "total_orders", "total_revenue_price", "total_freight",
        "total_revenue_total", "num_unique_sellers", "recency_days", "tenure_days",
        "avg_items_per_order", "avg_items_per_seller", "avg_price", "std_price",
        "min_price", "max_price", "avg_freight", "std_freight", "avg_price_per_freight",
        "units_last_30d", "orders_last_30d", "ratio_30d_total",
        "units_last_90d", "orders_last_90d", "ratio_90d_total",
        "units_last_180d", "orders_last_180d", "ratio_180d_total",
        "avg_days_between_orders",
        "total_reviews", "avg_review_score", "min_review_score", "max_review_score",
        "std_review_score", "share_5star", "share_1star",
        "total_payment_volume", "avg_order_value", "avg_payment_installments",
        "avg_payment_methods", "share_credit_card", "share_boleto"
    ]
    
    if not order_items.empty:
        # --------------------------
        # 1. Core Sales & Product Aggregations
        # --------------------------
        core_agg = order_items.groupby("product_id").agg(
            total_units_sold=("order_item_id", "count"),
            total_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
            total_revenue_price=("price", "sum"),
            total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
            first_sale_ts=("ts", "min"),
            last_sale_ts=("ts", "max"),
            avg_price=("price", "mean"),
            std_price=("price", "std"),
            min_price=("price", "min"),
            max_price=("price", "max"),
            avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
            std_freight=("freight_value", "std"),
            num_unique_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique")
        ).reset_index()
        
        # Derive temporal and ratio features
        core_agg["recency_days"] = (seed_time - core_agg["last_sale_ts"]).dt.days
        core_agg["tenure_days"] = (core_agg["last_sale_ts"] - core_agg["first_sale_ts"]).dt.days
        core_agg["avg_items_per_order"] = core_agg["total_units_sold"] / core_agg["total_orders"].replace(0, np.nan)
        core_agg["avg_items_per_seller"] = core_agg["total_units_sold"] / core_agg["num_unique_sellers"].replace(0, np.nan)
        core_agg["total_revenue_total"] = core_agg["total_revenue_price"] + core_agg["total_freight"]
        core_agg["avg_price_per_freight"] = core_agg["avg_price"] / (core_agg["avg_freight"] + 1e-9)  # Avoid division by zero
        
        # --------------------------
        # 2. Recent Sales Trend Features
        # --------------------------
        time_windows = [30, 90, 180]
        for days in time_windows:
            cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=days)
            recent_sales = order_items.loc[order_items["ts"] >= cutoff]
            if not recent_sales.empty:
                recent_agg = recent_sales.groupby("product_id").agg(
                    **{
                        f"units_last_{days}d": ("order_item_id", "count"),
                        f"orders_last_{days}d": ("order_id", "nunique")
                    }
                ).reset_index()
                core_agg = core_agg.merge(recent_agg, on="product_id", how="left")
            else:
                core_agg[f"units_last_{days}d"] = 0
                core_agg[f"orders_last_{days}d"] = 0
        
        # Calculate ratio of recent sales to total sales
        for days in time_windows:
            core_agg[f"ratio_{days}d_total"] = (
                core_agg[f"units_last_{days}d"] / core_agg["total_units_sold"].replace(0, np.nan)
            )
        
        # --------------------------
        # 3. Average Days Between Consecutive Orders
        # --------------------------
        # Get unique (product, order, ts) pairs to avoid duplicate order timestamps
        order_timestamps = order_items[["product_id", "order_id", "ts"]].drop_duplicates()
        order_timestamps = order_timestamps.sort_values(["product_id", "ts"]).reset_index(drop=True)
        # Compute time since previous order per product
        order_timestamps["prev_ts"] = order_timestamps.groupby("product_id")["ts"].shift(1)
        order_timestamps["days_between"] = (order_timestamps["ts"] - order_timestamps["prev_ts"]).dt.days
        # Aggregate mean days between orders
        days_between_agg = order_timestamps.groupby("product_id")["days_between"].agg(
            avg_days_between_orders="mean"
        ).reset_index()
        core_agg = core_agg.merge(days_between_agg, on="product_id", how="left")
        
        # --------------------------
        # 4. Review Features
        # --------------------------
        if not reviews.empty:
            # Link products to reviews via unique (product, order) pairs (avoid duplicate reviews per item)
            product_order_links = order_items[["product_id", "order_id"]].drop_duplicates()
            product_reviews = product_order_links.merge(
                reviews[["order_id", "review_id", "review_score"]],
                on="order_id",
                how="inner"
            )
            # Base review aggregations
            review_agg = product_reviews.groupby("product_id").agg(
                total_reviews=("review_id", "nunique"),
                avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
                min_review_score=("review_score", "min"),
                max_review_score=("review_score", "max"),
                std_review_score=("review_score", "std")
            ).reset_index()
            # Calculate 1-star and 5-star share
            star_counts = product_reviews.groupby(["product_id", "review_score"])["review_id"].nunique().unstack(fill_value=0)
            for star in [1, 5]:
                if star not in star_counts.columns:
                    star_counts[star] = 0
            star_counts = star_counts.reset_index()[["product_id", 1, 5]].rename(columns={1: "count_1star", 5: "count_5star"})
            review_agg = review_agg.merge(star_counts, on="product_id", how="left")
            review_agg["share_5star"] = review_agg["count_5star"] / review_agg["total_reviews"].replace(0, np.nan)
            review_agg["share_1star"] = review_agg["count_1star"] / review_agg["total_reviews"].replace(0, np.nan)
            review_agg = review_agg.drop(columns=["count_1star", "count_5star"])
            # Merge to core aggregations
            core_agg = core_agg.merge(review_agg, on="product_id", how="left")
        else:
            # Add empty review columns
            for col in ["total_reviews", "avg_review_score", "min_review_score", "max_review_score", "std_review_score", "share_5star", "share_1star"]:
                core_agg[col] = np.nan
        
        # --------------------------
        # 5. Payment Features
        # --------------------------
        if not payments.empty:
            # First aggregate payments per order
            order_payments = payments.groupby("order_id").agg(
                total_order_payment=("payment_value", "sum"),
                avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
                num_payment_methods=("payment_sequential", "nunique"),
                uses_credit_card=("payment_type", lambda x: 1 if "credit_card" in x.values else 0),
                uses_boleto=("payment_type", lambda x: 1 if "boleto" in x.values else 0)
            ).reset_index()
            # Link to products via unique (product, order) pairs
            product_order_links = order_items[["product_id", "order_id"]].drop_duplicates()
            product_payments = product_order_links.merge(order_payments, on="order_id", how="inner")
            # Aggregate per product
            payment_agg = product_payments.groupby("product_id").agg(
                total_payment_volume=("total_order_payment", "sum"),
                avg_order_value=("total_order_payment", "mean"),
                avg_payment_installments=("avg_installments", "mean"),
                avg_payment_methods=("num_payment_methods", "mean"),
                share_credit_card=("uses_credit_card", "mean"),
                share_boleto=("uses_boleto", "mean")
            ).reset_index()
            # Merge to core aggregations
            core_agg = core_agg.merge(payment_agg, on="product_id", how="left")
        else:
            # Add empty payment columns
            for col in ["total_payment_volume", "avg_order_value", "avg_payment_installments", "avg_payment_methods", "share_credit_card", "share_boleto"]:
                core_agg[col] = np.nan
        
        # Set product_id as index for merging
        core_agg = core_agg.set_index("product_id")
        # Drop datetime columns (not usable as numeric features)
        core_agg = core_agg.drop(columns=["first_sale_ts", "last_sale_ts"])
        # Merge with base index
        features = base.merge(core_agg, left_index=True, right_index=True, how="left")
    else:
        # No valid sales data: create empty features DataFrame
        features = pd.DataFrame(index=base.index, columns=all_feature_cols)
    
    # --------------------------
    # Final Cleanup & Index Alignment
    # --------------------------
    # Fill missing values with meaningful defaults
    # Count/volume features: 0
    count_cols = [
        "total_units_sold", "total_orders", "total_revenue_price", "total_freight",
        "total_revenue_total", "num_unique_sellers", "units_last_30d", "orders_last_30d",
        "units_last_90d", "orders_last_90d", "units_last_180d", "orders_last_180d",
        "total_reviews", "total_payment_volume"
    ]
    for col in count_cols:
        if col in features.columns:
            features[col] = features[col].fillna(0)
    # Recency: large value (10000 days = ~27 years) to indicate never sold
    features["recency_days"] = features["recency_days"].fillna(10000)
    # Tenure: 0 for no sales history
    features["tenure_days"] = features["tenure_days"].fillna(0)
    # All remaining NaNs (averages, ratios, stds) fill with 0
    features = features.fillna(0)
    
    # Ensure all columns are numeric (float64 for consistency)
    features = features.astype(np.float64)
    # Reindex to exactly match input entity_ids (order and duplicates preserved)
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
    
    return features

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Extract tables from input database dictionary
    orders = db["orders"]  # Unused, but included for completeness
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]
    
    # --------------------------
    # 1. Filter historical data strictly before seed_time to avoid leakage
    # --------------------------
    # Filter order items to purchases made strictly before seed_time
    filtered_items = order_items[order_items["ts"] < seed_time].copy()
    
    # Filter reviews to those created before seed_time
    filtered_reviews = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time].copy()
    
    # Filter payments to those recorded before seed_time
    filtered_payments = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time].copy()
    
    # --------------------------
    # 2. Aggregate sales features from order items
    # --------------------------
    sales_agg = filtered_items.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_units=("order_item_id", "count"),
        total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        last_purchase_ts=("ts", "max"),
        first_purchase_ts=("ts", "min")
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Compute time-based features from purchase timestamps
    sales_agg["days_since_last_purchase"] = (seed_time - sales_agg["last_purchase_ts"]).dt.days
    sales_agg["days_since_first_purchase"] = (seed_time - sales_agg["first_purchase_ts"]).dt.days
    sales_agg["purchase_frequency"] = sales_agg["total_orders"] / (
        (sales_agg["first_purchase_ts"] - sales_agg["last_purchase_ts"]).dt.days.abs() + 1
    )
    
    # Drop intermediate timestamp columns and add history flag
    sales_agg = sales_agg.drop(columns=["last_purchase_ts", "first_purchase_ts"])
    sales_agg["has_sales_history"] = 1
    
    # --------------------------
    # 3. Aggregate review features
    # --------------------------
    # Get unique (order, product) pairs to avoid duplicate review counts for same product in one order
    unique_order_product = filtered_items[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates()
    
    # Link reviews to products via order ID
    product_reviews = unique_order_product.merge(
        filtered_reviews[["order_id", "review_score", "review_creation_date", "review_answer_timestamp"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    
    # Aggregate review metrics
    review_agg = product_reviews.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_reviews=("order_id", "count"),
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        last_review_ts=("review_creation_date", "max"),
        answered_reviews=("review_answer_timestamp", lambda x: x.notna().sum())
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Compute derived review features
    review_agg["days_since_last_review"] = (seed_time - review_agg["last_review_ts"]).dt.days
    review_agg["review_answer_rate"] = review_agg["answered_reviews"] / review_agg["total_reviews"]
    
    # Clean up intermediate columns and add flag
    review_agg = review_agg.drop(columns=["last_review_ts", "answered_reviews"])
    review_agg["has_reviews"] = 1
    
    # --------------------------
    # 4. Aggregate payment features
    # --------------------------
    # First aggregate payments per order to get order-level payment metrics
    order_payments = filtered_payments.groupby("order_id").agg(
        total_order_payment=("payment_value", "sum"),
        avg_order_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        uses_credit_card=("payment_type", lambda x: (x == "credit_card").any()),
        uses_boleto=("payment_type", lambda x: (x == "boleto").any()),
        uses_voucher=("payment_type", lambda x: (x == "voucher").any()),
        uses_debit_card=("payment_type", lambda x: (x == "debit_card").any())
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Link order payment metrics to products
    product_payments = unique_order_product.merge(
        order_payments,
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    
    # Aggregate payment metrics per product
    payment_agg = product_payments.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_order_total=("total_order_payment", "mean"),
        avg_installments=("avg_order_installments", "mean"),
        credit_card_rate=("uses_credit_card", "mean"),
        boleto_rate=("uses_boleto", "mean"),
        voucher_rate=("uses_voucher", "mean"),
        debit_card_rate=("uses_debit_card", "mean")
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Add flag for payment data
    payment_agg["has_payment_data"] = 1
    
    # --------------------------
    # 5. Merge all features into base dataset
    # --------------------------
    # Create base dataframe with input product IDs to ensure full coverage
    base = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": entity_ids})
    
    # Merge all feature groups into base (left join to preserve all input IDs)
    features = base.merge(sales_agg, on="product_id", how="left")
    features = features.merge(review_agg, on="product_id", how="left")
    features = features.merge(payment_agg, on="product_id", how="left")
    
    # --------------------------
    # 6. Clean and impute missing values
    # --------------------------
    # Fill binary flag columns (0 = no history)
    flag_cols = ["has_sales_history", "has_reviews", "has_payment_data"]
    for col in flag_cols:
        features[col] = features[col].fillna(0).astype(int)
    
    # Fill count/rate/price columns with 0 (no data = 0 value)
    numeric_fill0_cols = [
        "total_orders", "total_units", "total_revenue",
        "avg_price", "avg_freight", "purchase_frequency",
        "total_reviews", "avg_review_score", "review_answer_rate",
        "avg_order_total", "avg_installments",
        "credit_card_rate", "boleto_rate", "voucher_rate", "debit_card_rate"
    ]
    for col in numeric_fill0_cols:
        features[col] = features[col].fillna(0)
    
    # Fill time-since columns with large value (no event = very long time)
    time_cols = ["days_since_last_purchase", "days_since_first_purchase", "days_since_last_review"]
    for col in time_cols:
        features[col] = features[col].fillna(9999).astype(int)
    
    # --------------------------
    # 7. Engineer additional derived features
    # --------------------------
    # Average order value (total revenue per unique order)
    features["avg_order_value"] = features["total_revenue"] / features["total_orders"].replace(0, np.nan)
    features["avg_order_value"] = features["avg_order_value"].fillna(0)
    
    # Average units per unique order
    features["units_per_order"] = features["total_units"] / features["total_orders"].replace(0, np.nan)
    features["units_per_order"] = features["units_per_order"].fillna(0)
    
    # --------------------------
    # 8. Final formatting: reindex to match input entity IDs exactly
    # --------------------------
    # Set product ID as index, then reindex to input order (handles duplicates correctly)
    features = features.set_index("product_id")
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
    
    return features

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db['orders']
    items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']

    # Данные только до момента предсказания
    orders = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] <= seed_time]
    items = items[items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids)]

    # Объединяем заказы и их позиции
    df = orders.merge(items, on='order_id', how='inner')

    if not df.empty:
        # Базовые агрегаты по товару
        grouped = df.groupby('product_id').agg(
            n_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
            n_items=('order_item_id', 'count'),
            n_customers=('customer_id', 'nunique'),
            price_avg=('price', 'mean'),
            price_total=('price', 'sum'),
            price_min=('price', 'min'),
            price_max=('price', 'max'),
            price_std=('price', 'std'),
            freight_avg=('freight_value', 'mean'),
            freight_total=('freight_value', 'sum'),
            ts_min=('order_purchase_timestamp', 'min'),
            ts_max=('order_purchase_timestamp', 'max')
        ).reset_index()

        # Время, прошедшее с первой и последней покупки
        grouped['days_since_last'] = (seed_time - grouped['ts_max']).dt.days
        grouped['days_since_first'] = (seed_time - grouped['ts_min']).dt.days
        grouped['span_days'] = (grouped['ts_max'] - grouped['ts_min']).dt.days

        # Активность за последние 90 дней
        threshold = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
        recent = df[df['order_purchase_timestamp'] > threshold]
        if recent.empty:
            cnt90 = pd.DataFrame(columns=['product_id', 'n_orders_90d'])
        else:
            cnt90 = recent.groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique().rename('n_orders_90d').reset_index()

        grouped = grouped.merge(cnt90, on='product_id', how='left')
        grouped['n_orders_90d'] = grouped['n_orders_90d'].fillna(0)
        grouped['was_purchased_last_90'] = (grouped['n_orders_90d'] > 0).astype(int)

        # Средний интервал между заказами (если их было больше одного)
        grouped['avg_interval_days'] = grouped.apply(
            lambda r: r['span_days'] / (r['n_orders'] - 1) if r['n_orders'] > 1 else 0,
            axis=1
        )

        # Отзывы (только созданные до момента предсказания)
        reviews_ok = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] <= seed_time]
        review_m = df[['order_id', 'product_id']].merge(
            reviews_ok[['order_id', 'review_score']],
            on='order_id',
            how='inner'
        )
        if review_m.empty:
            rev_agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=['product_id', 'avg_review_score', 'n_reviews'])
        else:
            rev_agg = review_m.groupby('product_id')['review_score'].agg(
                ['mean', 'count']
            ).rename(columns={'mean': 'avg_review_score', 'count': 'n_reviews'}).reset_index()

        grouped = grouped.merge(rev_agg, on='product_id', how='left')
        grouped = grouped.drop(columns=['ts_min', 'ts_max'], errors='ignore')
    else:
        # Если данных по товарам нет, создаём пустой каркас
        grouped = pd.DataFrame(columns=[
            'product_id', 'n_orders', 'n_items', 'n_customers',
            'price_avg', 'price_total', 'price_min', 'price_max', 'price_std',
            'freight_avg', 'freight_total', 'days_since_last', 'days_since_first',
            'span_days', 'n_orders_90d', 'was_purchased_last_90',
            'avg_interval_days', 'avg_review_score', 'n_reviews'
        ])

    # Устанавливаем индекс и приводим к требуемому списку товаров
    grouped = grouped.set_index('product_id')
    grouped = grouped.reindex(entity_ids)

    # Заполняем пропуски
    for col in ['days_since_last', 'days_since_first']:
        if col in grouped.columns:
            grouped[col] = grouped[col].fillna(999.0)

    for col in grouped.columns:
        if col.startswith('days_'):
            continue
        grouped[col] = grouped[col].fillna(0.0)

    return grouped.astype(float)

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time):
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)
    # базовый DataFrame с нулевыми признаками
    result = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)
    feature_names = [
        'has_sales', 'count_orders', 'total_price', 'avg_price', 'median_price', 'std_price',
        'total_freight', 'avg_freight', 'num_unique_customers', 'num_unique_sellers',
        'count_orders_30', 'count_orders_60', 'count_orders_90',
        'sum_price_30', 'sum_price_60', 'sum_price_90',
        'total_reviews', 'avg_review_score', 'positive_review_ratio',
        'total_payment_value', 'avg_payment_value', 'total_payments',
        'avg_nunique_payment_type', 'avg_installments',
        'days_since_first', 'days_since_last', 'avg_interval_days', 'purchase_frequency',
        'avg_order_item_count', 'avg_order_total_price', 'avg_order_total_freight'
    ]
    for col in feature_names:
        result[col] = 0.0

    orders = db['orders']
    order_items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    # заказы до seed_time
    orders_before = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] <= seed_time]
    # объединяем с order_items
    items_orders = order_items.merge(
        orders_before[['order_id', 'customer_id', 'order_purchase_timestamp']],
        on='order_id', how='inner'
    )
    items_orders = items_orders[items_orders['product_id'].isin(entity_ids)]

    if not items_orders.empty:
        # дни до seed_time
        items_orders['days_before_seed'] = (seed_time - items_orders['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.days
        # окна
        items_orders['in_30'] = (items_orders['days_before_seed'] <= 30).astype(int)
        items_orders['in_60'] = (items_orders['days_before_seed'] <= 60).astype(int)
        items_orders['in_90'] = (items_orders['days_before_seed'] <= 90).astype(int)
        items_orders['price_30'] = items_orders['price'] * items_orders['in_30']
        items_orders['price_60'] = items_orders['price'] * items_orders['in_60']
        items_orders['price_90'] = items_orders['price'] * items_orders['in_90']

        # агрегаты по заказам (размер, общая стоимость)
        order_item_counts = order_items.groupby('order_id').size().reset_index(name='order_item_count')
        order_total_price = order_items.groupby('order_id')['price'].sum().reset_index(name='order_total_price')
        order_total_freight = order_items.groupby('order_id')['freight_value'].sum().reset_index(name='order_total_freight')
        items_orders = items_orders.merge(order_item_counts, on='order_id', how='left')
        items_orders = items_orders.merge(order_total_price, on='order_id', how='left')
        items_orders = items_orders.merge(order_total_freight, on='order_id', how='left')

        # отзывы
        relevant_order_ids = items_orders['order_id'].unique()
        reviews_before = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] <= seed_time]
        reviews_before = reviews_before[reviews_before['order_id'].isin(relevant_order_ids)]
        if not reviews_before.empty:
            reviews_before['positive'] = (reviews_before['review_score'] >= 4).astype(int)
            reviews_agg = reviews_before.groupby('order_id').agg(
                count_reviews=('review_id', 'count'),
                avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
                positive_review_ratio=('positive', 'mean')
            ).reset_index()
        else:
            reviews_agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=['order_id', 'count_reviews', 'avg_review_score', 'positive_review_ratio'])
        items_orders = items_orders.merge(reviews_agg, on='order_id', how='left')

        # платежи
        payments_before = payments[payments['order_id'].isin(relevant_order_ids)]
        if not payments_before.empty:
            payments_agg = payments_before.groupby('order_id').agg(
                total_payment_value=('payment_value', 'sum'),
                avg_payment_value=('payment_value', 'mean'),
                count_payments=('payment_sequential', 'count'),
                nunique_payment_type=('payment_type', 'nunique'),
